Theory TD_warrow

section ‹Warrowing TD›

text‹In this theory, we first prove the partial correctness of the warrowing TD and later, with
  additional assumptions, its equivalence with the TD with widening and narrowing in phases. The
  warrowing TD extends the vanilla TD by dynamically tracking potential warrowing points.
  The warrowing operator is applied at warrowing points in function @{term iterate} to
  accelerate fixpoint iteration. Compared to the vanilla TD, the warrowing TD is no longer
  guaranteed to return partial solutions. Instead, computed assignments are only partial
  post-solutions to the given system of equations.›

theory TD_warrow
  imports Basics TD_wn_phases
begin

text‹We first use a locale to specify the context for the definitions. Later, extensions of this
  locale are used to specify further assumptions for the proofs.›

locale TD_warrow_defs =
  fixes T :: "('x,'d::order_bot) eqsT"
  fixes widening :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "∇" 65)
    and narrowing :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "Δ" 70)
begin

subsection ‹The Warrowing Operator›

text‹The warrowing is defined as a dynamic operator that dispatches to widening or narrowing based
  on the current relation of the old value @{term a} and the new value @{term b}. For non-monotonic
  equation systems, the warrowing solver may switch between widening and narrowing phases multiple
  times before reaching a fixpoint---or even never terminate.›

definition warrowing :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "∇Δ" 65)
  where "warrowing a b = (if b ≤ a then a Δ b else a ∇ b)"


subsection‹Definition of the Solver Algorithm›

text‹As the TD with widening/narrowing phases, TD with warrowing uses a set @{term point} to
  dynamically track unknowns at which to apply warrowing. In case a transitive self-dependence of
  an unknown is detected in function @{term query}, the solver marks the unknown as point.
  The warrowing operator is applied all unknowns in points in the function @{term iterate}.›

function (domintros)
    query :: "'x ⇒ 'x ⇒ ('x,'d) state ⇒ 'd × ('x,'d) state" and
  iterate :: "'x ⇒ ('x,'d) state ⇒ 'd × ('x,'d) state" and
     eval :: "'x ⇒ ('x,'d) strategy_tree ⇒ ('x,'d) state ⇒ 'd × ('x,'d) state" where
  "query y x state = (
    let (xd, state) =
      if x ∈ called state then
        (mlup (σ state) x, state ⦇point := insert x (point state)⦈)
      else
        iterate x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)
    in (xd, state ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y⦈))"
| "iterate x state = (
    if x ∉ stabl state then
      let point⇩x = x ∈ point state in
      let (xd, state) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) in
      let d_new = if ¬ point⇩x then xd else mlup (σ state) x ∇Δ xd in
      if d_new = mlup (σ state) x then
        (d_new, state ⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈)
      else
        let (infl', stabl') = destab x (infl state) (stabl state) in
        iterate x (state ⦇infl := infl', stabl := stabl', σ := (σ state)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)
    else
      (mlup (σ state) x, state ⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈))"
| "eval x t state = (case t of
      Answer d ⇒ (d, state)
    | Query y g ⇒ (let (yd, state) = query x y state in eval x (g yd) state))"
  by pat_completeness auto

definition solve :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'd) map × 'x set" where
  "solve x = (
    let state = ⦇called = {}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈ in
    let (d, state) = iterate x (state ⦇ called := insert x (called state) ⦈) in
    (σ state, stabl state))"

definition query_dom where
  "query_dom y x state = query_iterate_eval_dom (Inl (y, x, state))"
declare query_dom_def [simp]
definition iterate_dom where
  "iterate_dom x state = query_iterate_eval_dom (Inr (Inl (x, state)))"
declare iterate_dom_def [simp]
definition eval_dom where
  "eval_dom x t state = query_iterate_eval_dom (Inr (Inr (x, t, state)))"
declare eval_dom_def [simp]

definition solve_dom where
  "solve_dom x =
    iterate_dom x ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"

lemmas dom_defs = query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def


subsection ‹Refinement of Auto-Generated Rules›

lemmas query_iterate_eval_pinduct[consumes 1, case_names Query Iterate Eval]
  = query_iterate_eval.pinduct(1)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of y x state for y x state
    ]
    query_iterate_eval.pinduct(2)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of x state for x state
    ]
    query_iterate_eval.pinduct(3)[
      folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def,
      of x t state for x t state
    ]

lemmas iterate_pinduct[consumes 1, case_names Iterate]
  = query_iterate_eval_pinduct(2)[where ?P="λy x state. True"
    and ?R="λx t state. True", simplified (no_asm_use),
    folded query_dom_def iterate_dom_def eval_dom_def]

declare query.psimps[simp] iterate.psimps[simp] eval.psimps[simp]


subsection ‹Domain Lemmas›

lemma dom_backwards_pinduct:
  shows "query_dom y x state
    ⟹ x ∉ (called state) ⟹ iterate_dom x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
  and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ x ∉ (stabl state) ⟹ (eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) ∧
        ((xd, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)
          ⟶ d_new = (if x ∉ (point state) then xd else mlup (σ state1) x ∇Δ xd)
          ⟶ mlup (σ state1) x ≠ d_new
          ⟶ (infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1) ⟶
          iterate_dom x (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)))"
  and "eval_dom x (Query y g) state
    ⟹ (query_dom x y state ∧
        ((yd, state') = query x y state ⟶
          eval_dom x (g yd) state'))"
proof (induction y x state and x state and x "Query y g" state
    arbitrary: and xd state1 d_new infl2 stabl2 and y g yd state'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case
    apply (rule query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs])
    using Query.hyps(2) Query.prems by auto
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case apply (intro impI conjI)
  subgoal
    apply (rule query_iterate_eval.domintros(3)[folded dom_defs])
    using Iterate.hyps(2)[OF Iterate.prems] by fastforce+
  subgoal
    apply (rule query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs])
    using Iterate.hyps(3)[OF Iterate.prems, folded dom_defs] by (fastforce split: prod.splits)+
  done
next
  case (Eval x state)
  then show ?case using query_iterate_eval.domintros(1,3) by simp
qed


subsection ‹Case Rules›

lemma iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases[consumes 3]:
  assumes "iterate_dom x state"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x state"
  obtains (Stable) "x ∈ (stabl state)"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state) x"
    and "state' = state ⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈"
  | (Fixpoint) state1
  where "x ∉ (stabl state)" and "x ∉ (point state)"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "mlup (σ state') x = xd"
    and "state' = state1 ⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈"
  | (WN_Fixpoint) xd1 state1
  where "x ∉ (stabl state)" and "x ∈ (point state)"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state') x ∇Δ xd1"
    and "mlup (σ state') x = xd"
    and "state' = state1 ⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈"
  | (Continue) xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2
  where "x ∉ (stabl state)"
    and "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    and "d_new = (if x ∉ (point state) then xd1 else mlup (σ state1) x ∇Δ xd1)"
    and "d_new ≠ mlup (σ state1) x"
    and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and "iterate_dom x (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state') =
          iterate x (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
proof(cases "x ∈ (stabl state)" rule: case_split[case_names Stable Unstable])
  case Stable
  then show ?thesis using that(1) assms(1,2) by auto
next
  case Unstable
  then have sldom: "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(2)
    by simp
  then obtain xd1 state1
    where slapp: "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) = (xd1, state1)"
    by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
  then obtain d_new
    where d_new: "d_new = (if x ∉ (point state) then xd1 else mlup (σ state1) x ∇Δ xd1)"
    by blast
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "mlup (σ state1) x = d_new" rule: case_split[case_names Fixpoint Continue])
    case Fixpoint
    then show ?thesis
      using Unstable sldom slapp d_new assms that(2,3)
      by (cases "x ∈ point state") auto
  next
    case Continue
    obtain infl2 stabl2 where destab: "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1) = (infl2, stabl2)"
      by (cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)")
    then have dom:
        "iterate_dom x (state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
      using Unstable Continue slapp d_new assms(1) dom_backwards_pinduct(2) by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using Unstable Continue sldom slapp d_new assms destab that(4)
      by (cases "x ∈ (point state)") (auto simp add: Let_def)
  qed
qed

lemma query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic[consumes 2]:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  obtains (Iterate) state1
  where "x ∉ (called state)"
    and "iterate_dom x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = iterate x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    and "state' = state1 ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) x y⦈"
  | (Lookup) "x ∈ (called state)"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state) x"
    and "state' = state ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y, point := insert x (point state)⦈"
  using assms that dom_backwards_pinduct(1)
  by (cases "x ∈ (called state)") (auto split!: prod.splits)

lemma eval_query_answer_cases_basic[consumes 2]:
  assumes "eval_dom x t state"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x t state"
  obtains (Query) y g yd state1
  where "t = Query y g"
    and "query_dom x y state"
    and "(yd, state1) = query x y state"
    and "eval_dom x (g yd) state1"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd) state1"
  | (Answer) "t = Answer xd"
    and "state' = state"
  using assms dom_backwards_pinduct(3) that
  by (cases t; auto split: prod.splits)

lemma c_same:
  shows
    "query_dom y x state ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state ⟹ called state' = called state"
    "iterate_dom x state ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state ⟹ called state' = called state - {x}"
    "eval_dom x t state ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state ⟹ called state' = called state"
proof (induction y x state and x state and x t state
       arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
       rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state)
  show ?case using Query(1,3)
  proof (cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic)
    case (Iterate state1)
    then show ?thesis using Query(2)[of xd state1] by simp
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis by fastforce
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case using Iterate(1,4)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case Fixpoint
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2) by simp
  next
    case (WN_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    then show ?thesis using Iterate.IH(2) by simp
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3)]
        Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3) _ Continue(4,5) _ Continue(6),
                      simplified, OF Continue(8)]
      by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval(1, 4)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases_basic)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    then show ?thesis
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ Query(5), simplified] by simp
  qed simp
qed

lemma iterate_fmlookup:
  assumes "iterate_dom x state"
    and "(xd, state') = iterate x state"
  shows "mlup (σ state') x = xd"
  using assms
proof(induction rule: iterate_pinduct)
  case Iterate
  show ?case
    using Iterate.hyps Iterate.prems
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Continue
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate.IH(1) c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)] Iterate(3) by fastforce
  qed simp+
qed

corollary query_fmlookup:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  shows "mlup (σ state') x = xd"
  using assms iterate_fmlookup dom_backwards_pinduct(1)[of y x state]
  by (auto split: prod.splits if_splits)

lemma query_iterate_lookup_cases[consumes 2]:
  assumes "query_dom y x state"
    and "(xd, state') = query y x state"
  obtains (Iterate) state1
  where "x ∉ (called state)"
    and "iterate_dom x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    and "(xd, state1) = iterate x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
    and "state' = state1 ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) x y⦈"
    and "mlup (σ state') x = xd"
  | (Lookup) "x ∈ (called state)"
    and "xd = mlup (σ state) x"
    and "state' = state ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y, point := insert x (point state)⦈"
  apply (rule query_iterate_lookup_cases_basic[OF assms])
  using iterate_fmlookup[of x "state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈"]
  by (simp_all split: if_splits del: dom_defs)

lemma eval_query_answer_cases[consumes 2]:
  assumes "eval_dom x t state"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x t state"
  obtains (Query) y g yd state1
  where "t = Query y g"
    and "query_dom x y state"
    and "(yd, state1) = query x y state"
    and "eval_dom x (g yd) state1"
    and "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd) state1"
    and "mlup (σ state1) y = yd"
  | (Answer) "t = Answer xd"
    and "state' = state"
  apply (rule eval_query_answer_cases_basic[OF assms])
  by (auto simp: query_fmlookup[of x _ state])


subsection ‹Program Refinement for Code Generation›

text‹To derive executable code for the TD, we do a program refinement and define an
  equivalent solve function based on partial\_function with options that can be used for the code
  generation.›

datatype ('a,'b) istate = Q "'a × 'a × ('a, 'b) state"
  | I "'a × ('a, 'b) state"
  | E "'a × ('a,'b) strategy_tree × ('a, 'b) state"

partial_function (option) solve_rec_c ::
  "('x, 'd) istate ⇒ ('d × ('x, 'd) state) option"
  where
  "solve_rec_c s = (case s of Q (y,x,state) ⇒ Option.bind
      (if x ∈ (called state) then
        Some (mlup (σ state) x, state ⦇point := insert x (point state)⦈)
      else
        solve_rec_c (I (x, state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)))
      (λ (xd, state). Some (xd, state ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y⦈))
  | I (x,state) ⇒
      if x ∉ (stabl state) then
        let p0 = point state in Option.bind (
        solve_rec_c (E (x, (T x), state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))) (λ(xd, state).
        let d_new = if x ∉ p0 then xd else mlup (σ state) x ∇Δ xd in
        if mlup (σ state) x = d_new then
          Some (mlup (σ state) x, state ⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈)
        else
          let (infl', stabl') = destab x (infl state) (stabl state) in
          solve_rec_c (I (x, state ⦇infl := infl', stabl := stabl', σ := (σ state)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)))
      else
        Some (mlup (σ state) x, state ⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈)
  | E (x,t,state) ⇒ (case t of
        Answer d ⇒ Some (d, state)
      | Query y g ⇒ (
          Option.bind (solve_rec_c (Q (x, y, state))) (λ(yd, state).
          solve_rec_c (E (x, g yd, state))))))"

definition solve_rec_c_dom where "solve_rec_c_dom p ≡ ∃σ. solve_rec_c p = Some σ" for p

declare solve_rec_c.simps[simp,code]

definition solve_c :: "'x ⇒ (('x, 'd) map × 'x set) option" where
  "solve_c x = Option.bind (solve_rec_c (I (x,
    ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈)))
    (λ(d, state). Some (σ state, stabl state))"

definition solve_c_dom :: "'x ⇒ bool" where "solve_c_dom x ≡ ∃σ. solve_c x = Some σ"

text‹We prove the equivalence of the refined solver function for code generation and the initial
  version used for the partial correctness proof.›

lemma query_iterate_eval_solve_rec_c_equiv:
  shows "query_dom y x state ⟹ solve_rec_c_dom (Q (y,x,state))
    ∧ query y x state = the (solve_rec_c (Q (y,x,state)))"
  and "iterate_dom x state ⟹ solve_rec_c_dom (I (x,state))
    ∧ iterate x state = the (solve_rec_c (I (x,state)))"
  and "eval_dom x t state ⟹ solve_rec_c_dom (E (x,t,state))
    ∧ eval x t state = the (solve_rec_c (E (x,t,state)))"
proof (induction y x state and x state and x t state
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "x ∈ (called state)")
    case True
    then have "solve_rec_c (Q (y, x, state)) = Some (mlup (σ state) x,
        state ⦇point := insert x (point state), infl := fminsert (infl state) x y⦈)"
      by simp
    moreover have "query y x state = (mlup (σ state) x,
        state⦇point := insert x (point state), infl := fminsert (infl state) x y⦈)"
      using query.psimps[folded dom_defs] Query(1) True by force
    ultimately show ?thesis unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
  next
    case False
    obtain d1 state1 where
        I: "iterate x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈) = (d1, state1)"
      using prod_cases5 by fastforce
    then have J: "query y x state = (d1, state1 ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) x y⦈)"
      using False Query.IH(1) query.pelims[folded dom_defs] by fastforce
    then have "solve_rec_c (I (x, state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)) = Some (d1, state1)"
      using Query(2) False I by (simp add: solve_rec_c_dom_def)
    then have "solve_rec_c (Q (y, x, state)) =
        Some (d1, state1 ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) x y⦈)"
      using False by simp
    moreover have "solve_rec_c_dom (Q (y, x, state))"
      using Query(2) False unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by fastforce
    ultimately show ?thesis using Query J unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "x ∈ (stabl state)")
    case True
    have "iterate_dom x state ∧ iterate x state = (mlup (σ state) x,
        state ⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈)"
      using True iterate.psimps query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)
      unfolding iterate_dom_def
      by presburger
    then show ?thesis using True unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
  next
    case False
    obtain p0 where "p0 = point state" by blast
    obtain d1 state1 where
        eval: "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) = (d1, state1)"
        "solve_rec_c (E (x, (T x), state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)) = Some (d1, state1)"
      using Iterate(2) solve_rec_c_dom_def False by force
    define d_new where "d_new = (if x ∉ (point state) then d1 else mlup (σ state1) x ∇Δ d1)"
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "d_new = mlup (σ state1) x")
      case True
      have "iterate x state = (d_new, state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := point state1 - {x}⦈)"
        using eval iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF Iterate(1)] True False d_new_def
        by (auto simp: Set.remove_eq)
      moreover have "solve_rec_c (I (x, state))
          = Some (d_new, state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := point state1 - {x}⦈)"
        using eval False True d_new_def by (auto simp: Set.remove_eq)
      ultimately show ?thesis unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
    next
      case False
      obtain infl2 stabl2 where
        destab: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
        by (cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") auto
      let ?state2 = "state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈"
      have "solve_rec_c_dom (I (x, ?state2))"
        and "iterate x ?state2 = the (solve_rec_c (I (x, ?state2)))"
        using Iterate(3)[OF ‹x ∉ (stabl state)› _ eval(1)[symmetric] _ d_new_def False destab]
        by blast+
      moreover have "iterate x state  = iterate x ?state2"
        using eval iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF Iterate(1)] False ‹x ∉ (stabl state)›
          destab d_new_def
        by (auto split: prod.split)
      moreover have "solve_rec_c (I (x, state)) = solve_rec_c (I (x, ?state2))"
        using ‹x ∉ (stabl state)› False eval(2) destab[symmetric] d_new_def
        by (auto simp add: Let_def)
      ultimately show ?thesis unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
    qed
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case
  proof (cases t)
    case (Answer d)
    then have "eval x t state = (d, state)"
      using eval.psimps query_iterate_eval.domintros(3) dom_defs(3) by fastforce
    then show ?thesis using Eval Answer unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
  next
    case (Query y g)
    then obtain d1 state1 where
        query: "solve_rec_c (Q (x, y, state)) = Some (d1, state1)"
          "query x y state = (d1, state1)"
      using Query Eval(2) unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
    then have "solve_rec_c_dom (E (x, g d1, state1))"
        "eval x (g d1) state1 = the (solve_rec_c (E (x, g d1, state1)))"
      using Eval(3)[OF Query] by auto
    moreover have "eval x t state = eval x (g d1) state1"
      using Eval.IH(1) Query eval.psimps eval_dom_def query
      by fastforce
    moreover have "solve_rec_c (E (x, t, state))
        = solve_rec_c (E (x, g d1, state1))"
      using Query query solve_rec_c.simps[of "E (x,t,state)"]
      by (simp del: solve_rec_c.simps)
    ultimately show ?thesis using solve_rec_c_dom_def by force
  qed
qed

lemma solve_rec_c_query_iterate_eval_equiv:
  shows "solve_rec_c s = Some r ⟹ (case s of
        Q (x,y,state) ⇒ query_dom x y state
          ∧ query x y state = r
      | I (x,state) ⇒ iterate_dom x state
          ∧ iterate x state = r
      | E (x,t,state) ⇒ eval_dom x t state
          ∧ eval x t state = r)"
proof (induction arbitrary: s r rule: solve_rec_c.fixp_induct)
  case 1
  then show ?case using option_admissible by fast
next
  case 2
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (3 S)
  show ?case
  proof (cases s)
    case (Q a)
    obtain y x state where "a = (y, x, state)" using prod_cases3 by blast
    have "query_dom y x state ∧ query y x state = r"
    proof (cases "x ∈ called state")
      case True
      then have "Some (mlup (σ state) x,
          state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y, point := insert x (point state)⦈) = Some r"
        using 3(2) Q ‹a = (y, x, state)› by auto
      then show ?thesis using query.psimps[folded query_dom_def, of y x state]
            query_iterate_eval.domintros(1)[folded query_dom_def, of x state] True by force
    next
      case False
      then have "Option.bind (S (I (x, state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈))) (λ(d,state).
          Some (d, state ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) x y⦈)) = Some r"
        using 3(2) Q ‹a = (y, x, state)› by simp
      then obtain d1 state1
        where "S (I (x, state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)) = Some (d1 ,state1)"
        and "(d1, state1 ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) x y⦈) = r"
        by (cases "S (I (x, state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈))") auto
      then have "iterate_dom x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)
          ∧ iterate x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈) = (d1, state1)"
        using 3(1) unfolding iterate_dom_def by fastforce
      then show ?thesis using False ‹(d1, state1 ⦇infl := fminsert (infl state1) x y⦈) = r›
        by (simp add: query_iterate_eval.domintros(1) False)
    qed
    then show ?thesis using Q ‹a = (y, x, state)› by simp
  next
    case (I a)
    obtain x state where "a = (x, state)" by fastforce
    show ?thesis
    proof(cases "x ∈ (stabl state)")
      case True
      then have "(mlup (σ state) x, state ⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈) = r"
        using I ‹a = (x, state)› 3(2) by simp
      moreover have "iterate_dom x state ∧ iterate x state = (mlup (σ state) x,
          state ⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈)"
        using True query_iterate_eval.domintros(2) iterate.psimps dom_defs by fastforce
      ultimately show ?thesis using I ‹a = (x, state)› by simp
    next
      case False
      obtain p0 where "p0 = point state" by blast
      with False have IH1: "Option.bind (S (E (x, T x, state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)))
          (λ(d, state1).
            let d_new = if x ∉ p0 then d else mlup (σ state1) x ∇Δ d in
            if mlup (σ state1) x = d_new then
              Some (mlup (σ state1) x, state1 ⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈)
            else let (infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1) in
            S (I (x, state1 ⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈))) =
          Some r"
        using 3(2) I ‹a = (x, state)› by simp
      then obtain d state1 d_new
        where eval_some: "S (E (x, T x, state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))
          = Some (d, state1)" and
          d_new: "d_new = (if x ∉ (point state) then d else mlup (σ state1) x ∇Δ d)"
        using 3(2) I
        by (cases "S (E (x, T x, state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))") auto
      then have eval: "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)
          ∧ eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) = (d, state1)"
        using 3(1) d_new unfolding TD_plain.eval_dom_def by force
      have "iterate_dom x state ∧ iterate x state = r"
      proof (cases "mlup (σ state1) x = d_new")
        case True
        have "(d_new, state1 ⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈) = r"
          using IH1 eval_some True d_new ‹p0 = point state› by auto
        moreover have "iterate_dom x state"
          using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs] False True eval d_new by fastforce
        ultimately show ?thesis
          using iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs] False True eval d_new by fastforce
      next
        case False
        obtain infl2 stabl2 where
            destab: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
          by (cases "destab x (infl state1)  (stabl state1)") auto
        let ?state2 = "state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈"
        have "S (I (x, ?state2)) = Some r"
          using IH1 False eval_some d_new destab ‹p0 = point state› by (auto split: prod.splits)
        then have iter_cont: "iterate_dom x ?state2 ∧ iterate x ?state2 = r"
          using 3(1) unfolding iterate_dom_def by fastforce
        then have "iterate_dom x state"
          using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs, of x state] eval
            ‹x ∉ (stabl state)› False destab d_new
          by (cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") (auto split: if_splits)
        then show ?thesis
          using iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, of x state] ‹x ∉ (stabl state)› destab eval
            False iter_cont d_new
          by (cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") (auto split: if_splits)
      qed
      then show ?thesis using I ‹a = (x, state)› by simp
    qed
  next
    case (E a)
    obtain x t state where "a = (x, t, state)" using prod_cases3 by blast
    then have "s = E (x, t, state)" using E by auto
    have "eval_dom x t state ∧ eval x t state = r"
    proof (cases t)
      case (Answer d)
      then have "eval_dom x t state"
        unfolding eval_dom_def using query_iterate_eval.domintros(3) by fastforce
      moreover have "eval x t state = (d, state)"
        using Answer eval.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF calculation] by auto
      moreover have "(d, state) = r"
        using 3(2) ‹s = E (x, t, state)› Answer by simp
      ultimately show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case (Query y g)
      then have A: "Option.bind (S (Q (x, y, state))) (λ(yd, state).
        S (E (x, g yd, state))) = Some r" using ‹s = E (x, t, state)› 3(2)
        by simp
      then obtain yd state1
          where S1: "S (Q (x, y, state)) = Some (yd, state1)"
          and S2: "S (E (x, g yd, state1)) = Some r"
        by (cases "S (Q (x, y, state))") auto
      then have "query_dom x y state
          ∧ query x y state = (yd, state1)"
          and "eval_dom x (g yd) state1 ∧ eval x (g yd) state1 = r"
        using 3(1)[OF S1] 3(1)[OF S2] unfolding TD_plain.dom_defs by force+
      then show ?thesis
        using query_iterate_eval.domintros(3)[folded dom_defs] eval.psimps[folded dom_defs] Query
        by fastforce
    qed
    then show ?thesis using E ‹a = (x, t, state)› by simp
  qed
qed

theorem term_equivalence: "solve_dom x ⟷ solve_c_dom x"
  using solve_rec_c_query_iterate_eval_equiv query_iterate_eval_solve_rec_c_equiv(2)[of x]
  unfolding solve_dom_def solve_c_dom_def solve_rec_c_dom_def solve_c_def
  by (cases "solve_rec_c (I (x, ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {},
      point = {}⦈))")
     fastforce+

theorem value_equivalence: "solve_dom x ⟹ ∃σ. solve_c x = Some σ ∧ solve x = σ"
proof goal_cases
  case 1
  then obtain r where "solve_rec_c (I (x,
      ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈)) = Some r
    ∧ iterate x ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈ = r"
    using query_iterate_eval_solve_rec_c_equiv(2)[OF 1[unfolded solve_dom_def]]
    unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def solve_dom_def
    by fastforce
  then show ?case unfolding solve_c_def solve_def by (auto split: prod.split)
qed

text‹With the equivalence of the refined version and the initial version proven, we can specify a
  the code equation.›

lemma solve_code_equation [code]:
  "solve x = (case solve_c x of Some r ⇒ r
  | None ⇒ Code.abort (STR ''Input not in domain'') (λ_. solve x))"
proof (cases "solve_dom x")
  case True
  then show ?thesis
    using solve_c_def solve_def value_equivalence by fastforce
next
  case False
  then have "solve_c x = None" using solve_c_dom_def term_equivalence by (meson option.exhaust)
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

end

text‹Finally, we use a dedicated rewrite rule for the code generation of the solver locale.›

global_interpretation TD_warrow_Interp: TD_warrow_defs T w n for T w n
  defines TD_warrow_Interp_solve = TD_warrow_Interp.solve
  done

export_code TD_warrow_Interp_solve in SML


subsection ‹Lemmas about Warowing Operator.›

locale TD_warrow = TD_warrow_defs T widening narrowing
  for T :: "('x, 'd :: order_bot) eqsT"
    and widening :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "∇" 65)
    and narrowing :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "Δ" 70) +
  assumes widening_ge_2: "b ≤ a ∇ b"
    and narrowing_ge: "b ≤ a ⟹ b ≤ a Δ b"
begin

lemma warrowing_properties:
  "b ≤ a ∇Δ b"
  "a = a ∇Δ b ⟹ b ≤ a"
  unfolding warrowing_def
  using narrowing_ge[of b a] widening_ge_2[of b a] by (auto split: if_splits)

subsection ‹Well-formedness of Infl and Stabl›

subsubsection ‹Predicate for Well-formed Infl Map and Stable Set›

text‹For the warrowing TD, we adapt the predicate of valid solver states already used in the proof
  of the vanilla TD. Instead of demanding @{term σ} to be a partial solution of the equation
  system, it may only be a partial post-solution. Note that the composition of the set of warrowing
  points @{term point} is not relevant for the partial correctness proof, but is only crucial for
  termination.›

definition well_formed_infl_stabl where
  "well_formed_infl_stabl state ≡
    called state ⊆ stabl state
    ∧ fset (fmdom (infl state)) ⊆ stabl state
    ∧ (∀y∈stabl state - called state. ∀x ∈ dep T (σ state) y. y ∈ slookup (infl state) x)"

abbreviation "update_rel x state state' ≡
    stabl state ⊆ stabl state' ∧
    (∀u. slookup (infl state) u ⊆ slookup (infl state') u) ∧
    (∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ (stabl state - {x}) = {})"

lemma well_formed_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl:
  assumes "x ∈ called state"
    and "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)"
  shows "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
  using assms
proof -
  have "called state - {x} ⊆ stabl state ≡ called state ⊆ insert x (stabl state)"
    using assms(1)
    by (simp add: subset_insert_iff)
  moreover have "stabl state - (called state - {x}) ⊇ insert x (stabl state) - called state"
    using assms(1)
    by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis
    using assms(2)
    unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
    by auto
qed

lemma well_formed_infl_stabl_simp_p_upd:
  assumes "well_formed_infl_stabl state"
  shows "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇point := p'⦈)"
  using assms unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by simp


subsubsection ‹Preservation of the Well-formedness›

text‹The following lemmas show that the well-formedness of infl and stabl are preserved when
  destabilizing an unknown and updating its value in @{term σ}.›

lemma destab_upd_preserves_well_formed_infl_stabl:
  assumes "called state - {x} ⊆ stabl state"
      and "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
      and "(∀x∈stabl state1 - (called state1 - {x}).
            ∀y∈dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y)"
      and "fset (fmdom (infl state1)) ⊆ stabl state1"
      and "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
      and "called state1 = called state"
    shows "well_formed_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
           σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
proof -
  show ?thesis
    unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
  proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
    case 1 show ?case
      using assms(1,5,6) by simp
    case 2 show ?case
      using destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl[OF assms(2,4)] by simp
    case 3 show ?case
      using destab_and_upd_preserves_dep_closed_in_infl[OF assms(2,3)] by simp
  qed
qed


subsubsection ‹Induction proof›

text‹The well-formedness of infl and stabl is shown by induction. The proof closely aligns with the
  equivalence proof of TD and TD\_plain.›

lemma well_formed_infl_stabl_ind:
  shows "query_dom y x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state'
      ∧ (∀ξ ∈ stabl state. mlup (σ state) ξ = mlup (σ state') ξ)
      ∧ y ∈ slookup (infl state') x
      ∧ update_rel y state state'"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ x ∈ called state
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)
      ∧ (∀ξ ∈ stabl state. mlup (σ state) ξ = mlup (σ state') ξ)
      ∧ x ∈ stabl state'
      ∧ update_rel x state state'"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state'
      ∧ (∀ξ ∈ stabl state. mlup (σ state) ξ = mlup (σ state') ξ)
      ∧ (∀y∈dep_aux (σ state') t. x ∈ slookup (infl state') y)
      ∧ update_rel x state state'"
proof(induction y x state and x state and y t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    moreover note IH = Query.IH(2)[simplified, OF Iterate(1,3) Query.prems(2)]
    ultimately show ?thesis
    proof(intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 5
      hence "infl state' = fminsert (infl state1) x y"
        and "∀u. slookup (infl state) u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u"
        by simp+
      then show ?case by (metis le_supI1 slookup_fminsert_other slookup_fminsert_same)
    next
      case 6
      have "∀ξ. (slookup (infl state1) ξ - slookup (infl state) ξ) ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
        using 6(2,3,6) by (cases "x ∈ (stabl state)"; simp)
      then show ?case
        by (auto simp: 6(4) intro!: TD.infl_upd_diff)
    qed (auto simp: well_formed_infl_stabl_def fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using Query.prems(2)
      by (auto simp add: well_formed_infl_stabl_def fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)

  note inv = well_formed_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl[OF Iterate.prems(2,3)]
  note IH' = Iterate.IH(2)[rotated 3, OF inv]

  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    hence "state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈ = state'" by fastforce
    moreover have "well_formed_infl_stabl state'"
      using Iterate.prems(3) well_formed_infl_stabl_simp_p_upd Stable(3)
      by fast
    moreover have "state⦇called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈
        = state⦇point := (point state) - {x}, called := called state - {x}⦈" by auto
    ultimately show ?thesis using Stable(1,3) by auto
  next
    case Fixpoint
    note IH = IH'[OF Fixpoint(1) _ Fixpoint(4), folded dep_def]
    then show ?thesis by (auto simp: well_formed_infl_stabl_def Fixpoint(6))
  next
    case (WN_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    note IH = IH'[OF WN_Fixpoint(1) _ WN_Fixpoint(4), folded dep_def]
    then show ?thesis by (auto simp: well_formed_infl_stabl_def WN_Fixpoint(7))
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = IH'[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3)]

    have infl_closed:
      "(∀x∈stabl state1 - (called state1 - {x}). ∀y∈dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y)"
      using IH[unfolded well_formed_infl_stabl_def, folded dep_def] c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)]
      by auto

    note infl2_stabl2_def = destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)]
    have stabl_inc: "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
      using Iterate.prems(3) Continue(1) TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1 state x]
        destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)] IH
      unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
      by auto

    note c_same = c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3), simplified]
    note xcalled1 = Iterate.prems(2)[simplified c_same[symmetric]]
    have inv: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
      apply (rule destab_upd_preserves_well_formed_infl_stabl[OF _ Continue(6) infl_closed _
             stabl_inc])
      using Iterate.prems(3) IH c_same unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by simp+

    note ih = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3) _ Continue(4,5,6) _
        Continue(8), simplified, OF xcalled1 inv]

    with IH stabl_inc show ?thesis
    proof(elim conjE, intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 2
      have "∀ξ∈stabl state. mlup (σ state1) ξ = mlup (σ state') ξ"
        using 2(1,16) Continue(1)
        unfolding mlup_def
        by (auto simp add: fun_upd_apply split: if_splits)
      then show ?case using 2(4) by simp
    next
      case 5
      show ?case
      proof(intro allI subsetI, goal_cases)
        case (1 ξ u)
        then have "ξ ∈ stabl state"
          using Iterate.prems(3) TD.stabl_infl_empty[of ξ "stabl state" "infl state"]
          unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
        then have "ξ ∉ insert x (influenced_by (infl state1) x)"
          using 1(1) Continue(1) conjunct2[OF infl2_stabl2_def] stabl_inc by blast
        then show ?case
          using IH conjunct1[OF infl2_stabl2_def] 1 5(12)
          apply (auto simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set simp del: fmdrop_set_insert)
          by blast
      qed
    next case 6
      show ?case
      proof(intro allI, goal_cases)
        case (1 ξ)
        have "slookup infl2 ξ ⊆ slookup (infl state1) ξ"
          using conjunct1[OF infl2_stabl2_def] unfolding fmlookup_default_def by auto
        moreover have "(slookup (infl state') ξ - slookup infl2 ξ) ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
          using Continue(1) 6(13) stabl_inc by (cases "x ∈ stabl2") auto
        moreover have "(slookup (infl state1) ξ - slookup (infl state) ξ) ∩ (stabl state) = {}"
          using Continue(1) 6(14) by auto
        ultimately show ?case by blast
      qed
    qed (auto split: prod.split)
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3) Eval.prems(2)]

    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3), rotated 1, OF Query(5) conjunct1[OF IH], simplified]

    have y_stabl1: "y ∈ stabl state1"
      using IH TD.stabl_infl_empty[of y "stabl state1" "infl state1"]
      unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
      by fastforce
    then have mlup: "mlup (σ state') y = yd"
      using ih query_fmlookup[OF Query(2,3)] by simp

    show ?thesis using IH ih Query(1) mlup
    proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 3
      have "x ∈ slookup (infl state') y" using IH ih y_stabl1 by blast
      then show ?case using Query(1) mlup ih by auto
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case by blast
    next
      case 6
      have "∀u. (slookup (infl state') u - slookup (infl state1) u) ∩ (stabl state1 - {x}) = {}"
        using ih by auto
      then show ?case using IH by blast
    qed auto
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: Eval.prems(2))
  qed
qed


subsection ‹Partial Correctness›

abbreviation eq_subsumed :: "('x,'d) map ⇒ 'x set ⇒ bool" where
  "eq_subsumed sigma vars ≡ (∀x ∈ vars. eq T x sigma ≤ mlup sigma x)"

lemma destab_upd_preserves_part_post_sol:
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and "eq_subsumed (σ state1) (stabl state1 - called state)"
    and "∀y∈stabl state1 - (called state - {x}). ∀x∈dep T (σ state1) y. y ∈ slookup (infl state1) x"
    and "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ xd'"
  shows "eq_subsumed ((σ state1)(x ↦ xd')) (stabl2 - (called state - {x}))"
proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
  case (1 y)
  have stabl2_def: "stabl2 = (stabl state1) - influenced_by (infl state1) x"
    using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)] by fast
  have x_no_dep: "∀y ∈ stabl2 - (called state - {x}). x ∉ dep T (σ state1) y"
    using destab_x_no_dep[OF assms(1,3)] by simp
  have eq_y_upd: "eq T y ((σ state1)(x ↦ xd')) = eq T y (σ state1)"
    using 1 eq_mupd_no_dep[of x T "σ state1" y] x_no_dep
    by auto
  show ?case
  proof (cases "y = x")
    case True
    then show ?thesis using assms(4) eq_y_upd unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_same)
  next
    case False
    then have "y ∈ stabl state1 - called state"
      using 1 stabl2_def by force
    then have "eq T y (σ state1) ≤ mlup (σ state1) y"
      using assms(2) by blast
    then show ?thesis using False eq_y_upd unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_other)
  qed
qed

lemma eq_subsumed_ind:
  shows "query_dom y x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_subsumed (σ state) ((stabl state) - (called state))
    ⟹ eq_subsumed (σ state') (stabl state' - called state)"
    and "iterate_dom x state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
    ⟹ x ∈ (called state)
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
    ⟹ eq_subsumed (σ state) (stabl state - (called state - {x}))
    ⟹ eq_subsumed (σ state') (stabl state' - (called state - {x}))"
    and "eval_dom x t state
    ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
    ⟹ x ∈ stabl state
    ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
    ⟹ eq_subsumed (σ state) ((stabl state) - (called state))
    ⟹ eq_subsumed (σ state') (stabl state' - called state)
        ∧ traverse_rhs t (σ state') = xd"
proof(induction y x state and x state and y t state
    arbitrary: xd state' and xd state' and xd state'
    rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    show ?thesis
      using Query.IH(2)[simplified, OF Iterate(1,3) Query.prems(2)] Query.prems(3)
      by (simp add: Iterate(4))
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using Query.prems(3) by simp
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)

  note inv = well_formed_infl_stabl_simp_c_stabl[OF Iterate.prems(2,3)]
  have "eq_subsumed (σ state) (insert x (stabl state) - (called state))"
    using Iterate.prems(2,4) by blast
  hence part_post: "eq_subsumed (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)) (stabl
    (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) - called (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))"
    by simp
  note IH' = Iterate.IH(2)[rotated 4, OF inv part_post]

  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    show ?thesis using Stable(3) Iterate.prems(4) by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    note IH = IH'[OF Fixpoint(1) _ Fixpoint(4), folded dep_def]
    then show ?thesis using Fixpoint(5,6) by auto
  next
    case (WN_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    note IH = IH'[OF WN_Fixpoint(1) _ WN_Fixpoint(4), folded dep_def]

    have "eq T x (σ state') ≤ mlup (σ state') x"
      using WN_Fixpoint(5)[simplified WN_Fixpoint(6)[symmetric], THEN warrowing_properties(2)] IH
        WN_Fixpoint(7) unfolding eq_def by force

    with IH WN_Fixpoint(7) show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    note IH = IH'[OF Continue(1) _ Continue(3)]
    note valid_stabl_infl_1 = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(2,3) inv, simplified]
    note c_c1_same = c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3), simplified]
    hence c_c1_upd_same:
      "called (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈) = called state"
      by force

    have valid_stabl_infl_2: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
      σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new), called := called state - {x}⦈)"
    proof -
      have infl_closed: "(∀x∈stabl state1 - (called state1 - {x}).
          ∀y∈dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y)"
        using valid_stabl_infl_1[folded dep_def] c_c1_same
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by blast
      have stabl_inc: "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
        using Iterate.prems(3) Continue(1) TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1]
          destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)] valid_stabl_infl_1
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
      then show ?thesis
        using destab_upd_preserves_well_formed_infl_stabl[OF _ Continue(6) infl_closed _
              stabl_inc] Iterate.prems(3) valid_stabl_infl_1 c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)]
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
    qed

    have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
      using Continue(4) IH warrowing_properties(1) by (auto split: if_splits)
    then have inv: "eq_subsumed ((σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)) (stabl2 - (called state - {x}))"
      using destab_upd_preserves_part_post_sol[OF Continue(6), of state1 d_new] IH
        valid_stabl_infl_1 c_c1_same
      unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def dep_def by fastforce

    have "x ∈ called (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈)"
      using c_c1_same Iterate.prems(2) by simp
    note ih' = Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(1) _ Continue (3), rotated 2, OF Continue(4-6) refl
        Continue(8) this, simplified c_c1_upd_same, OF valid_stabl_infl_2 _ refl refl]

    then show ?thesis using inv by auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    note IH = Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3) Eval.prems(3,4)]

    note valid_infl_stabl_1 = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF Query(2,3) Eval.prems(3)]
    then have x_stabl1: "x ∈ stabl state1" using Eval.prems(2) by fast

    note ih = Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) refl Query(5) x_stabl1 conjunct1[OF valid_infl_stabl_1]
                         IH[simplified c_same(1)[OF Query(2,3), symmetric]]]
    thm c_same(1)[OF Query(2,3)]

    have y_stabl1: "y ∈ stabl state1"
      using valid_infl_stabl_1[unfolded well_formed_infl_stabl_def]
            TD.stabl_infl_empty[of y "stabl state1" "infl state1"]
      by fastforce
    then have "mlup (σ state1) y = mlup (σ state') y"
      using well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Query(4,5)] valid_infl_stabl_1 x_stabl1 by simp
    then have mlup: "mlup (σ state') y = yd"
      using query_fmlookup[OF Query(2,3)] by simp

    show ?thesis using ih Query(1) mlup c_same(1)[OF Query(2,3), symmetric] by auto
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(2,4) by simp
  qed
qed


text‹Since the initial solver state fulfills the valid solver state predicate, we can conclude from
  the above lemma that the warrowing TD returns a partial post-solution for the queried unknown
  @{term x} and all unknowns on which it transitively depends on.›

corollary partial_correctness:
  assumes "solve_dom x"
    and "solve x = (sigma, vars)"
  shows "part_post_solution T x sigma vars"
proof -
  obtain xd state where app: "(xd, state) =
      iterate x ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"
    using assms
    unfolding solve_def
    by (cases "iterate x ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈") auto
  hence stabl'_def: "vars = stabl state" and σ'_def: "sigma = σ state" and c_empty: "called state = {}"
    using assms(2) c_same(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] app]
    unfolding solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
  have "well_formed_infl_stabl state" "x ∈ stabl state"
    using well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] app]
    unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
    by auto
  then have "∀ξ∈stabl state. dep T (σ state) ξ ⊆ stabl state"
    using TD.dep_subset_stable[of "infl state" "stabl state" "called state"] c_empty
    unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
  then show ?thesis
    using eq_subsumed_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] app] ‹x ∈ stabl state›
    unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def stabl'_def σ'_def by auto
qed

end


subsection ‹With Monotonicity›

text‹In this section, we consider stronger assumptions, namely that the widening
  operator is precise and that the equation system has monotonic right-hand sides with monotonic
  dependencies. These additional assumptions allow us to prove TD\_warrow equivalent to
  TD\_wn\_phases. With the equivalence and assuming that the set of unknowns is finite, the total
  correctness of both solvers can then easily be derived, as we have already proven partial
  correctness for TD\_warrow and termination of TD\_wn\_phases.›


subsubsection ‹Construction of Precise Widening Operators›

text‹First, we show that the assumption on the precision of the widening operator can be lifted as
  a precise widening operator can be constructed from any, possibly imprecise, widening operator.›

abbreviation is_widening where
  "is_widening op ≡ (∀a b. b ≤ op a b) ∧ wf {(a, b). ∃c. a ≠ b ∧ a = op b c}"

abbreviation is_precise_widening where
  "is_precise_widening op ≡ is_widening op ∧ (∀a b. b ≤ a ⟶ op a b = a)"

definition create_precise_widening where
  "create_precise_widening op ≡ (λa b. if b ≤ a then a else op a b)"

lemma create_precise_widening:
  assumes "is_widening op"
  shows "is_precise_widening (create_precise_widening op)"
  unfolding create_precise_widening_def
  using assms
  by (auto intro: wf_subset)


subsubsection ‹Characterize Set of Post-Solution Unknowns›

text‹To prove the equivalence of both solvers, we introduce three ghost variables that are
  collected in a record of type ghost_state. The ghost variables @{term c⇩n}, @{term post} and
  @{term pinfl} track unknowns which are being iterated with narrowing, for which a post-solution
  is already computed, and their dependencies, respectively. The set of unknowns @{term post}
  is designed to be a super set of the unknowns in @{term stabl}. Note, however,
  that it may contain more as both solvers may destabilize and keep iterating unknowns for which a
  stable value is already found to improve their values with narrowing.›

record ('x,'d) post_state =
  c⇩n :: "'x set"
  pinfl :: "('x, 'x list) fmap"
  post :: "'x set"

locale TD_warrow_mono = TD_warrow T widening narrowing
  for T :: "('x, 'd :: order_bot) eqsT"
    and widening :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "∇" 65)
    and narrowing :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "Δ" 70) +

  assumes narrowing_le: "b ≤ a ⟹ a Δ b ≤ a"
    and widening_precise: "b ≤ a ⟹ a ∇ b = a"
begin

definition narrowing_inv :: "('x,'d) state ⇒ ('x, 'd) post_state ⇒ bool" where
  "narrowing_inv state post_state ≡
    eq_subsumed (σ state) (post post_state - (called state - c⇩n post_state))
    ∧ c⇩n post_state ⊆ called state
    ∧ stabl state ⊆ post post_state
    ∧ fset (fmdom (pinfl post_state)) ⊆ post post_state
    ∧ (∀y∈post post_state - (called state - c⇩n post_state). ∀x ∈ dep T (σ state) y.
        y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state) x)
    ∧ (∀u. slookup (infl state) u ⊆ slookup (pinfl post_state) u)"

definition update_rel_nar ::
  "'x ⇒ ('x,'d) state ⇒ ('x,'d) state ⇒ ('x, 'd) post_state ⇒ ('x, 'd) post_state ⇒ bool" where
  "update_rel_nar x state state' post_state post_state' ≡
    post post_state ⊆ post post_state' ∧
    (∀u ∈ post post_state. mlup (σ state') u ≤ mlup (σ state) u) ∧
    (∀u. slookup (pinfl post_state) u ⊆ slookup (pinfl post_state') u) ∧
    (∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state') u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
      ∩ (post post_state - ({x} - c⇩n post_state)) = {}) ∧
    c⇩n post_state' = c⇩n post_state"


paragraph ‹Destabilization Mechanism for Post Unknowns›

text‹We align the design of the ghost variables @{term c⇩n}, @{term post} and @{term pinfl} with the
  implementation of the solver's data structures @{term c⇩n}, @{term stabl} and @{term infl} to
  profit from already proven auxiliary lemmas. Unknowns are optimistically added to @{term post}
  whenever they are added to @{term stabl} and dependencies are recorded in @{term pinfl} when
  recorded in @{term infl}. The data structures differ, however, in that unknowns may be kept in
  @{term post} even if removed from @{term stabl}. In the following, we design a variant of the
  destabilization mechanism for @{term stabl} and @{term infl}. This variant is used to prune
  unknowns and entries from @{term post} and @{term pinfl} when @{term σ} no longer stores a
  (partial) post-solution for them, but explicitly avoids the removal of stable unknowns.›

inductive_set influenced_by_excl_cutoff for infl x c where
  base: "y ∉ c ⟹ fmlookup infl x = Some ys ⟹ y ∈ set ys
    ⟹ y ∈ influenced_by_excl_cutoff infl x c"
| step: "z ∈ influenced_by_excl_cutoff infl x c ⟹ y ∉ c ⟹ fmlookup infl z = Some ys
    ⟹ y ∈ set ys ⟹ y ∈ influenced_by_excl_cutoff infl x c"

lemma influenced_by_excl_cutoff_equiv:
  "influenced_by_excl_cutoff i x co = influenced_by_cutoff i x (co - {x}) - co"
proof -
  have "u ∈ influenced_by_cutoff i x (co - {x}) - co"
      if "u ∈ influenced_by_excl_cutoff i x co" for u
    using that(1)
  proof (induction rule: influenced_by_excl_cutoff.induct)
    case (base y ys)
    then show ?case by (simp add: influenced_by_cutoff.base)
  next
    case (step y z zs)
    then show ?case using influenced_by_cutoff.step by fastforce
  qed
  moreover have "u ∈ influenced_by_excl_cutoff i x co"
    if "u ∈ influenced_by_cutoff i x (co - {x})" "u ∉ co" for u
    using that
  proof (induction rule: influenced_by_cutoff.induct[consumes 1, case_names base step])
    case (base ys y)
    then show ?case by (simp add: influenced_by_excl_cutoff.base)
  next
    case (step y zs z)
    then show ?case
      by (metis Diff_iff influenced_by_excl_cutoff.base influenced_by_excl_cutoff.step singletonD)
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

definition destab_barrier :: "'x ⇒ ('x, 'd) post_state ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'd) post_state"
  where
  "destab_barrier x post_state b = (
   let i = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by_excl_cutoff (pinfl post_state) x b))
           (pinfl post_state) in
   let s = post post_state - influenced_by_excl_cutoff (pinfl post_state) x b in
   post_state⦇pinfl := i, post := s⦈)"

definition destab_post ::
  "'x ⇒ bool ⇒ ('x, 'd) post_state ⇒ 'x set ⇒ ('x, 'd) post_state" where
  "destab_post x x_truly_post post_state b =
    (if x_truly_post then post_state else destab_barrier x post_state b)"


paragraph ‹Preservation of the Invariant and Auxiliary Lemmas›

text‹In this section, we prove several auxiliary lemmas. They, e.g., help to argue that the
  restricted destabilization mechanism for post unknowns is sufficient, i.e., the resulting set
  is again closed under the dependencies and contains only unknowns for which a partial
  post-solution is already found.›

lemma lookup_in_influenced_cutoff:
  assumes "x ∉ s"
  shows "slookup i x ⊆ influenced_by_cutoff i x s"
proof(intro subsetI, goal_cases)
  case (1 y)
  then show ?case
    using influenced_by_cutoff.base[of x s i] assms
    by (cases rule: set_fmlookup_default_cases) simp
qed

lemma part_post_solution_preserved:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
    and "eq_subsumed (σ state1) truly_post"
    and "d ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
    and "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d"
  shows "eq_subsumed ((σ state1)(x↦d)) (insert x truly_post)"
proof -
  have "(σ state1)(x ↦ d) ⊑⇩m σ state1" using assms(3) by (simp add: fun_upd_apply mlup_def)
  then have "eq T u ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) ≤ eq T u (σ state1)" for u
    using assms(1) unfolding is_mono_eq_def by simp
  moreover have "eq T u (σ state1) ≤ mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) u"
    if "u ∈ insert x truly_post" for u
  proof (cases "u = x")
    case True
    then show ?thesis using assms(4) by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same mlup_def)
  next
    case False
    then show ?thesis using assms(2) that by (auto simp add: mlup_def fun_upd_other)
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis using order_trans by blast
qed

lemma nar_inv_after_update_if_post:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
    and "mono_deps T"
    and IH: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
    and post_inv: "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
    and dep_x_in_infl1: "∀u∈dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) u"
    and d_geq_eq: "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d"
    and d_leq_lookup: "d ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
    and destab_stabl: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
  shows "narrowing_inv (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d),
          called := called state1 - {x}⦈) (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state1 - {x}⦈)"
  unfolding narrowing_inv_def
proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)

  case 1
  then show ?case
    using part_post_solution_preserved[OF assms(1) _ d_leq_lookup d_geq_eq] IH
    unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto

  case 2
  then show ?case using IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto

  case 3
  then have "stabl state1 ⊆ post post_state1" using IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
  then show ?case using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab_stabl] by auto

  case 4
  show ?case using IH[unfolded narrowing_inv_def] by simp

  case 5
  have "(σ state1)(x ↦ d) ⊑⇩m σ state1" using d_leq_lookup by (simp add: fun_upd_apply mlup_def)
  then have "dep T ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) u ⊆ dep T (σ state1) u" for u
    using ‹mono_deps T› unfolding mono_deps_def by simp
  moreover have "∀y∈post post_state1 - (called state1 - {x} - (c⇩n post_state1 - {x})).
      ∀x∈dep T (σ state1) y. y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x"
    using IH dep_x_in_infl1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
  ultimately show ?case by auto

  case 6
  have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u" for u
    using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF destab_stabl]
    by (metis empty_iff empty_set fmlookup_default_drop_set subsetI)
  then show ?case using IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by fastforce
qed

lemma no_dep_on_x_if_post_after_destab:
  assumes destab_stabl_res_2: "stabl2 = stabl state1 - influenced_by (infl state1) x"
    and x_not_post: "x ∉ post post_state"
    and post_inv: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)"
    and nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈)"
    and update_rel_nar: "update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
          (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
    and post_inv1: "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
    and nar_inv1: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
    and dep_x_infl1: "∀y ∈ dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y"
    and c⇩n_same: "c⇩n post_state1 = c⇩n post_state"
    and u_in_post1: "u ∈ post post_state1"
    and u_not_cw: "u ∉ called state1 - (c⇩n post_state1) - {x}"
    and u_not_pinfl_cutoff_by_x:
        "u ∉ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2"
  shows "x ∉ dep T (σ state1) u"
proof -
  consider "u ∈ stabl2" | "u ∉ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x})"
    using u_not_pinfl_cutoff_by_x by blast
  then show ?thesis
  proof cases
    case 1
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "u ∈ stabl state1 - (called state1 - {x})")
      case True
      have "u ∉ influenced_by (infl state1) x" using destab_stabl_res_2 1 by auto
      then have "u ∉ slookup (infl state1) x" using lookup_in_influenced by fast
      then show ?thesis
        using post_inv1 dep_x_infl1 True unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by blast
    next
      case False
      then have "u ∈ c⇩n post_state1" using 1 destab_stabl_res_2 u_not_cw by blast
      then have "u ∈ c⇩n post_state - {x}" using c⇩n_same 1 False destab_stabl_res_2 by blast
      then have "u ∈ insert x (post post_state) - ({x} - c⇩n post_state)"
        using post_inv nar_inv unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def narrowing_inv_def by auto
      moreover have "slookup (pinfl post_state) x = {}"
        apply (intro TD.stabl_infl_empty)
        using x_not_post nar_inv unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
      ultimately have "u ∉ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x"
        using update_rel_nar[unfolded update_rel_nar_def] by fastforce
      then show ?thesis
        using nar_inv1 u_in_post1 u_not_cw dep_x_infl1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
    qed
  next
    case 2
    then have "u ∉ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x"
      using lookup_in_influenced_cutoff[of x "stabl2 - {x}"]
      by blast
    then show ?thesis
      using dep_x_infl1 nar_inv1 u_in_post1 u_not_cw unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
  qed
qed

lemma non_post_not_influenced:
  assumes "u ∈ influenced_by (pinfl post_state1) x"
    and x_not_post: "x ∉ post post_state"
    and lookup_diff: "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state1) u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
                      ∩ (post post_state - {x}) = {}"
    and pinfl_subset_post: "fset (fmdom (pinfl post_state)) ⊆ post post_state"
  shows "u ∉ post post_state"
    using assms(1)
proof (induction rule: influenced_by.induct[consumes 1, case_names base step])
  case (base ys y)
  have "slookup (pinfl post_state) x = {}"
    using x_not_post pinfl_subset_post TD.stabl_infl_empty by simp
  then have "∀u ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x. u ∉ post post_state - {x}"
    using lookup_diff by fastforce
  then have "y ∉ post post_state - {x}" using base by simp
  then show ?case using x_not_post by simp
next
  case (step y zs z)
  have "slookup (pinfl post_state) y = {}"
    using pinfl_subset_post step(4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by (meson TD.stabl_infl_empty)
  then have "z ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) y - slookup (pinfl post_state) y"
    by (simp add: step.hyps(2) step.hyps(3))
  then show ?case using lookup_diff x_not_post by blast
qed

lemma nar_inv_after_destab_update_if_not_post:
  assumes x_not_post: "x ∉ post post_state"
    and x_not_cn: "x ∉ c⇩n post_state"
    and post_inv: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)"
    and nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈)"
    and post_inv1: "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
    and nar_inv1: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
    and update_rel: "update_rel x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1"
    and update_rel_nar: "update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
          (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
    and destab_post: "post_state2 =
          destab_post x x_truly_post (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state1⦈) stabl2"
    and destab_stabl: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and xd1_def: "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d"
    and dep_x_infl1: "∀y ∈ dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y"
    and post_inv2: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
    and c_same: "called state1 = called state"
    and c⇩n_same: "c⇩n post_state1 = c⇩n post_state"
    and x_not_truly_post: "¬ x_truly_post"
  shows "narrowing_inv (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d),
          called := called state1 - {x}⦈) (post_state2⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state2 - {x}⦈)"
proof -
  have destab_post_res:
    "pinfl post_state2 = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x
                         (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2)) (pinfl post_state1)"
    "post post_state2 = post post_state1 -
                        (influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2)"
    "c⇩n post_state2 = c⇩n post_state1"
    using destab_post x_not_post influenced_by_excl_cutoff_equiv[of _ x stabl2] x_not_truly_post
    unfolding destab_post_def destab_barrier_def by (auto split: prod.splits)

  have destab_stabl_res:
    "infl2 = fmdrop_set (insert x (influenced_by (infl state1) x)) (infl state1)"
    "stabl2 = stabl state1 - influenced_by (infl state1) x"
    using destab_stabl destab_infl_stabl_relation[of infl2 stabl2 x] by auto

  have stabl_subset_post2: "stabl2 ⊆ post post_state2"
  proof -
    have "stabl state1 ⊆ post post_state1" using nar_inv1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by simp
    then show ?thesis
      using destab_post_res(2) destab_stabl_res(2) by auto
  qed

  show ?thesis
    unfolding narrowing_inv_def
  proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
    case 2
    then show ?case using destab_post_res(3) nar_inv1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto

    case 3
    then show ?case using stabl_subset_post2 by auto

    case 1
    have "eq T u (σ state1) ≤ mlup (σ state1) u"
      if "u ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - c⇩n post_state1)" for u
      using nar_inv1[unfolded narrowing_inv_def] that by simp
    then have "eq T u (σ state1) ≤ mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) u" if "x ≠ u"
        "u ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - {x} - c⇩n post_state1)" for u
      using that by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
    moreover have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) x"
      using nar_inv1 xd1_def by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same mlup_def)
    moreover have "eq T u ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) = eq T u (σ state1)"
      if "u ∈ post post_state2 - (called state1 - {x} - c⇩n post_state1)" for u
    proof -
      have "x ∉ dep T (σ state1) u"
        apply (intro no_dep_on_x_if_post_after_destab[OF destab_stabl_res(2) x_not_post post_inv
              nar_inv update_rel_nar post_inv1 nar_inv1 dep_x_infl1 c⇩n_same])
        using that destab_post_res(2) by auto
      then show ?thesis using eq_mupd_no_dep by force
    qed
    ultimately show ?case using destab_post_res(2,3) by force
  next
    case 4
    have "fset (fmdom (pinfl post_state1)) ⊆ post post_state1"
      using nar_inv1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
    then show ?case
      using destab_post_res(1,2) by (auto simp add: fmlookup_dom_iff split: if_splits)
  next
    case 5
    have "∀y∈post post_state1 - (called state1 - c⇩n post_state1 - {x}). ∀x∈dep T (σ state1) y.
        y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x"
      using nar_inv1 dep_x_infl1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
    show ?case
    proof (intro ballI, goal_cases)
      case (1 y z)
      then have y_post2: "y ∈ post post_state2"
        by simp
      have "x ∉ dep T (σ state1) y"
        apply (intro no_dep_on_x_if_post_after_destab[OF destab_stabl_res(2) _ post_inv nar_inv _
            post_inv1 nar_inv1 dep_x_infl1])
        using x_not_post update_rel_nar destab_post_res(2,3) 1(1) c⇩n_same by auto
      then have "dep T ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) y = dep T (σ state1) y"
        by (metis dep_eq mlup_eq_mupd_set)
      then have "z ∈ dep T (σ state1) y" using 1(2) by auto
      then have "y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) z"
      proof -
        have "∀y∈post post_state1 - ((called state1 - c⇩n post_state1) - {x}).
            ∀x∈dep T (σ state1) y. y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x"
          using nar_inv1 dep_x_infl1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
        moreover have "y ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - {x} - (c⇩n post_state1 - {x}))"
          using "1"(1) destab_post_res(2,3) by simp
        ultimately show ?thesis using ‹z ∈ dep T (σ state1) y› by blast
      qed
      have "z ≠ x" using ‹z ∈ dep T (σ state1) y› ‹x ∉ dep T (σ state1) y› by auto

      have "z ∈ post post_state1"
        using ‹y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) z› nar_inv1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def
        by (metis TD.stabl_infl_empty empty_iff)
      have "y ∈ post post_state1" using "1"(1) destab_post_res(2) by auto

      have "z ∉ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2"
      proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then have "z ∉ stabl2" "z ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x})"
          by auto
        then have "y ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x})"
          using influenced_by_cutoff.step[of z _ x "stabl2 - {x}"]
            ‹y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) z›
          by (meson Diff_iff set_fmlookup_default_cases)
        then have "y ∈ stabl2"
          using destab_post_res(2) influenced_by_excl_cutoff_equiv[of _ x stabl2] y_post2
          by auto
        have "y ∉ stabl2 - (called state - {x})"
        proof (rule ccontr, goal_cases)
          case 1
          have "∀ξ∈stabl2 - (called state1 - {x}). dep T ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) ξ ⊆ stabl2"
            apply (intro TD.dep_subset_stable[of infl2])
            using post_inv2
            unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
            by simp+
          then have "dep T (σ state1) y ⊆ stabl2"
            using ‹dep T ((σ state1)(x ↦ d)) y = dep T (σ state1) y› 1 c_same by blast
          then have "z ∈ stabl2" using ‹z ∈ dep T (σ state1) y› by auto
          then show ?case using ‹z ∉ stabl2› by simp
        qed
        then have "y ∈ called state" "y ≠ x" using ‹y ∈ stabl2› by auto
        then have "y ∈ stabl state"
          using post_inv nar_inv unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def narrowing_inv_def by auto
        then have "y ∈ post post_state" using nar_inv unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
        then have "y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state) z"
          using ‹y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) z› ‹y ∈ post post_state› ‹y ≠ x› update_rel_nar
          unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
        then have "z ∈ post post_state"
          using nar_inv TD.stabl_infl_empty[of z "post post_state" "pinfl post_state"]
          unfolding narrowing_inv_def by force
        have "y ∈ influenced_by (pinfl post_state1) x"
          using influenced_cutoff_subset
            ‹y ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x})›
          by fastforce
        have "y ∉ post post_state"
          apply (intro non_post_not_influenced[OF ‹y ∈ influenced_by (pinfl post_state1) x›
                 x_not_post])
          using nar_inv update_rel_nar unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def
          by auto
        then show False using ‹y ∈ post post_state› by blast
      qed
      then have "z ∉ insert x (influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x})
          - stabl2)"
        using ‹z ≠ x› by blast
      then have "slookup (pinfl post_state1) z = slookup (pinfl post_state2) z"
        using destab_post_res(1) by (metis fmlookup_default_drop_set)
      then show ?case using ‹y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) z› by simp
    qed
  next
    case 6
    then show ?case
    proof (intro allI, goal_cases)
      case (1 u)
      then show ?case
      proof (cases "u = x")
        case True
        then show ?thesis using destab_post_res(1) destab_stabl_res(1)
          by (simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set del: fmdrop_set_insert)
      next
        case False
        then show ?thesis
        proof (cases "u ∈ stabl2")
          case True
          have "slookup infl2 u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u"
            using destab_stabl_res(1) fmlookup_default_drop_set
            by (metis empty_iff empty_set subset_iff)
          moreover have "slookup (pinfl post_state2) u = slookup (pinfl post_state1) u"
            using destab_post_res(1) True False fmlookup_default_drop_set
            by (metis DiffD2 insertE)
          ultimately show ?thesis using nar_inv1 unfolding narrowing_inv_def by force
        next
          case False
          then have "slookup infl2 u = {}"
            using TD.stabl_infl_empty post_inv2 well_formed_infl_stabl_def
                destab_preserves_infl_dom_stabl destab_stabl post_inv1
            by metis
          then show ?thesis by simp
      qed
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma post_dom_incr:
  assumes post_inv: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)"
    and post_inv1: "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
    and nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈)"
    and nar_inv1: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
    and update_rel_nar: "update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
                         (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
    and destab: "post_state2 = destab_post x x_truly_post (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nx⦈) stabl2"
    and x_not_truly_post: "¬ x_truly_post ⟹ x ∉ post post_state ∧ x ∉ c⇩n post_state"
  shows "post post_state ⊆ post post_state2"
proof (cases x_truly_post)
  case True
  then show ?thesis
    using destab update_rel_nar unfolding destab_post_def update_rel_nar_def by simp
next
  case False
  then have "x ∉ c⇩n post_state" and x_not_post: "x ∉ post post_state"
    using x_not_truly_post by auto

  have "x ∉ fset (fmdom (pinfl post_state))"
    using nar_inv x_not_post unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
  then have "slookup (pinfl post_state) x = {}" by (simp add: TD.stabl_infl_empty)
  then have "influenced_by (pinfl post_state) x = {}"
    by (metis influenced_by_aux UN_E empty_iff equals0I)

  have post2_sub: "post post_state ⊆ post post_state1 - {x}"
    using update_rel_nar x_not_post unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
  have destab_post: "post post_state2 = post post_state1 -
      (influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2)"
    using destab influenced_by_excl_cutoff_equiv[of _ x] False
    unfolding destab_post_def destab_barrier_def by simp

  have U: "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state1) u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
      ∩ (post post_state - {x}) = {}"
    using ‹x ∉ c⇩n post_state› update_rel_nar unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
  have "u ∉ post post_state" if "u ∈ influenced_by (pinfl post_state1) x" for u
    using that
  proof (induction rule: influenced_by.induct[consumes 1, case_names base step])
    case (base ys y)
    have "∀u ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x. u ∉ post post_state - {x}"
      using U ‹slookup (pinfl post_state) x = {}› by fastforce
    then have "y ∉ post post_state - {x}" using base by simp
    then show ?case using x_not_post by simp
  next
    case (step y zs z)
    have "slookup (pinfl post_state) y = {}"
      apply (intro TD.stabl_infl_empty)
      using nar_inv step(4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by simp+
    then have "z ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) y - slookup (pinfl post_state) y"
      by (simp add: step.hyps(2) step.hyps(3))
    then show ?case using U x_not_post by blast
  qed

  moreover have "influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x})
      ⊆ influenced_by (pinfl post_state1) x"
    by (meson influenced_cutoff_subset)

  ultimately show ?thesis using post2_sub destab_post by blast
qed

lemma inf_infl_inf_cutoff_infl_or_stabl:
  assumes "u ∈ influenced_by (infl state1) x"
    and "x ∈ stabl state1"
    and stabl2: "stabl2 = stabl1 - influenced_by (infl state1) x"
    and "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
    and "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
    and "x ∉ stabl2"
  shows "u ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x stabl2 - stabl2"
  using assms(1)
proof (induction rule: influenced_by.induct[consumes 1, case_names base step])
  case (base ys y)
  then have "y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x"
    using assms(2,5) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by fastforce
  then have "y ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x stabl2" if "x ∉ stabl2"
    using lookup_in_influenced_cutoff that by fastforce
  moreover have "y ∉ stabl2"
    using influenced_by.base base.hyps(1) base.hyps(2) stabl2 assms(1) by fast
  ultimately show ?case using assms(6) by blast
next
  case (step y zs z)
  have "y ∈ stabl state1"
    using assms(4) step(2,3) unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by (meson fmdomI subsetD)
  then have "z ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) y"
    using step(2,3) assms(5) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by fastforce

  have "y ∉ stabl2" using step(1) stabl2 by simp
  then have "y ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x stabl2" if "x ∉ stabl2"
    using step(4) that by blast
  then have "z ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x stabl2" if "x ∉ stabl2"
    using ‹y ∉ stabl2› that influenced_by_cutoff.step[of y _ x stabl2]
      ‹z ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) y›
    by (meson set_fmlookup_default_cases)

  moreover have "z ∉ stabl2" by (metis DiffD2 influenced_by.step stabl2 step.hyps(1-3))

  ultimately show ?case using assms(6) by blast
qed

lemma destab_post_c_unchanged:
  assumes "post_state2 = destab_post x x_truly_post post_state1 stabl2"
  shows "c⇩n post_state2 = c⇩n post_state1"
  using assms
  unfolding destab_post_def destab_barrier_def
  by auto

lemma c_post_after_destab:
  assumes "(infl2, stabl2) = destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)"
    and "post_state2 = destab_post x x_truly_post (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nz⦈) stabl2"
    and "post post_state ⊆ post post_state2"
    and "narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈)"
    and "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
    and "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
    and "x ∈ stabl state1"
    and "¬ x_truly_post ⟹ x ∉ c⇩n post_state ∧ x ∉ post post_state ∧ x ∉ c⇩nz"
    and "x_truly_post ⟹ x ∈ c⇩nz"
  shows "(x ∉ c⇩n post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ post post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ stabl2)
         ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ post post_state2)"
proof (cases x_truly_post)
  case False
  then have "x ∉ c⇩n post_state" "x ∉ post post_state" "x ∉ c⇩nz" using assms(8) by blast+
  have "x ∉ post post_state2 - stabl2"
  proof -
    have "post_state2 = destab_barrier x (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nz⦈) stabl2"
      using assms(2) False unfolding destab_post_def by auto
    then have post2: "post post_state2 = post post_state1 -
        (influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x (stabl2 - {x}) - stabl2)"
      using influenced_by_excl_cutoff_equiv[of "pinfl post_state1" x stabl2]
      unfolding destab_barrier_def by simp
    have stabl2: "stabl2 = stabl state1 - influenced_by (infl state1) x"
      using destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF assms(1)] by simp
    have "slookup (pinfl post_state) x = {}"
      apply (intro TD.stabl_infl_empty[OF ‹x ∉ post post_state›])
      using assms(4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by simp
    then have "influenced_by (pinfl post_state) x = {}"
      apply (subst influenced_by_aux)
      by simp
    have "x ∈ stabl state1" using assms(7) by auto
    then have "u ∈ influenced_by_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x stabl2 - stabl2 ∨ x ∈ stabl2"
      if "u ∈ influenced_by (infl state1) x" for u
