      using inf_infl_inf_cutoff_infl_or_stabl that assms(5,6) stabl2 by force
    then show ?thesis using post2 stabl2 assms(5,7) unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
  qed
  then show ?thesis using destab_post_c_unchanged[OF assms(2)] ‹x ∉ c⇩nz› by auto
next
  case True
  then have "post_state2 = post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nz⦈" using assms(2) unfolding destab_post_def by simp
  moreover have "x ∈ post post_state1" using assms(6,7) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
  ultimately show ?thesis using assms(9)[OF True] by simp
qed

lemma narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post:
  assumes xcalled: "x ∈ called state"
      and wn_post: "(x ∉ c⇩n post_state ⟶ x ∉ post post_state - stabl state)
                      ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state ⟶ x ∈ post post_state)"
      and nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
                      (post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈)"
    shows "narrowing_inv (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)
            (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈)"
  using wn_post nar_inv xcalled unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto


paragraph ‹Induction Proof›

text‹We show by induction on the computation trace that there exist ghost variables
  @{term c⇩n}, @{term post} and @{term pinfl} that fulfill the @{term narrowing_inv}
  invariant and are updated consistently (@{term update_rel_nar}).›

lemma narrowing_inv_ind:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
    and "mono_deps T"
  shows "query_dom y x state
         ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
         ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
         ⟹ narrowing_inv state post_state
         ⟹ x ∈ dep T (σ state) y
         ⟹ ∃post_state'. narrowing_inv state' post_state'
             ∧ update_rel_nar y state state' post_state post_state'"
    and "iterate_dom x state
         ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
         ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
         ⟹ narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈)
         ⟹ x ∈ called state
         ⟹ (x ∉ c⇩n post_state ⟶ x ∉ post post_state - stabl state)
             ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state ⟶ x ∈ post post_state)
         ⟹ ∃post_state'.
             narrowing_inv (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈) post_state'
             ∧ update_rel_nar x (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)
               (post_state⦇c⇩n := insert x (c⇩n post_state)⦈)
               (post_state'⦇c⇩n := insert x (c⇩n post_state')⦈)"
    and "eval_dom x t state
         ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
         ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
         ⟹ narrowing_inv state post_state
         ⟹ x ∈ called state
         ⟹ subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t
         ⟹ set pre ⊆ stabl state
         ⟹ ∃post_state'. narrowing_inv state' post_state'
             ∧ update_rel_nar x state state' post_state post_state'"
proof (induction y x state and x state and x t state
       arbitrary: xd state' post_state and xd state' post_state and xd state' post_state pre
       rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    obtain c1⇩n where
      c1⇩n_def: "c1⇩n = (if x ∈ post post_state then insert x (c⇩n post_state) else (c⇩n post_state))"
      by fastforce
    let ?post_state = "post_state⦇c⇩n := c1⇩n⦈"
    have "c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩n post_state"
      using c1⇩n_def Iterate(1) Query.prems(3) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    have "(x ∉ c1⇩n ⟶ x ∉ post post_state - stabl state) ∧ (x ∈ c1⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post post_state)"
      using Iterate(1) Query.prems(3) c1⇩n_def unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    moreover have pinv: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)"
      using Iterate(1) Query.prems(2,4) c1⇩n_def by (auto split: if_splits)
    moreover have "narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c1⇩n - {x}⦈)"
      using Iterate(1) Query.prems(3) c1⇩n_def unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    ultimately obtain post_state1 where
      IH: "narrowing_inv (state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈) post_state1"
          "update_rel_nar x (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)
             (post_state⦇c⇩n := insert x c1⇩n⦈) (post_state1⦇c⇩n := insert x (c⇩n post_state1)⦈)"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,3), of ?post_state] by force

    have pinv1: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
           "update_rel x (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
           "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(2)[OF Iterate(2,3)] pinv by auto

    note c_same = c_same(2)[OF Iterate(2,3)]

    show ?thesis
    proof (intro exI[of _ "post_state1⦇pinfl := fminsert (pinfl post_state1) x y⦈"] conjI,
           goal_cases)
      case 1
      show ?case
        using IH(1) unfolding narrowing_inv_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 2
        then show ?case by (auto simp add: Iterate(4))
      next
        case 4
        have"x ∈ post post_state1" using 4 pinv1(3) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
        moreover have "fset (fmdom (fminsert (pinfl post_state1) x y)) =
          fset (fmdom (pinfl post_state1)) ∪ {x}"
          using Iterate(4) unfolding fminsert_def by simp
        ultimately show ?case using Iterate(4) IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
      next
        case 5
        then show ?case by (auto simp add: Iterate(4) ‹c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩n post_state› slookup_fminsert)
      next
        case 6
        show ?case
        proof (intro allI, goal_cases)
        case (1 u)
        then show ?case using Iterate(3,4) 1 6
          by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
      qed
      qed (auto simp add: Iterate(4))
    next
      case 2
      show ?case
        using IH unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 3
        have "slookup (pinfl post_state1) v ⊆ slookup (fminsert (pinfl post_state1) x y) v" for v
          using Iterate(4) unfolding fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def by auto
        then show ?case using 3 by fastforce
      next
        case 4
        show ?case
        proof (cases "y ∉ c⇩n post_state")
          case True
          then have "{y} - c⇩n post_state = {y}" by blast
          moreover have "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state1) u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
              ∩ post post_state = {}"
            using 4 Iterate(1) Query.prems(4) by simp
          ultimately show ?thesis
            apply simp using TD.infl_upd_diff[of _ _ _ x y] 4 by simp
        next
          case False
          then have "y ∈ c⇩n post_state" by auto
          have "y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state) x"
          proof -
            have "y ∈ post post_state - (called state - c⇩n post_state)"
              using Query.prems(2-4) False unfolding narrowing_inv_def well_formed_infl_stabl_def
              by auto
            then show ?thesis using Query.prems(3,4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
          qed
          then have "x ∈ post post_state"
            using Query.prems(3) TD.stabl_infl_empty[of x "post post_state" "pinfl post_state"]
            unfolding narrowing_inv_def by fastforce
          then have "y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) x"
            using 4 ‹y ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state) x› unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
          then have "slookup (fminsert (pinfl post_state1) x y) u = slookup (pinfl post_state1) u"
            for u
            by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
          then show ?thesis using Iterate(1) ‹y ∈ c⇩n post_state› 4 by auto
        qed
      next
        case 5
        then have "c⇩n post_state1 = c1⇩n - {x}" unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
        then show ?case using ‹c1⇩n - {x} = c⇩n post_state› by simp
      qed (auto simp add: Iterate(4))
    qed
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis
    proof (intro exI[of _ "post_state⦇pinfl := fminsert (pinfl post_state) x y⦈"] conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case
        using Query.prems(3) unfolding narrowing_inv_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 4
        have "x ∈ stabl state"
          using 4(1) Query.prems(2,4) unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
        then have "x ∈ post post_state" using 4 by auto
        then show ?case using 4 by (auto simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
      next
        case 5
        then show ?case by (auto simp add: fminsert_def fmlookup_default_def)
      next
        case 6
        then show ?case
        proof (intro allI, goal_cases)
          case (1 u)
          then show ?case
            by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_same slookup_fminsert_other)
        qed
      qed auto
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 3
        then show ?case unfolding fmlookup_default_def fminsert_def by auto
      next
        case 4
        then have "∀u. (slookup (fminsert (pinfl post_state) x y) u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
            ∩ (post post_state - {y}) = {}"
          by (simp add: TD.infl_upd_diff)
        then show ?case
        proof (intro allI, goal_cases)
          case (1 u)
          then show ?case
            using Query.prems(3,4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def
            by (cases "u = x") (auto simp add: slookup_fminsert_other slookup_fminsert_same)
        qed
      qed auto
    qed
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  have pinv: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Iterate.prems(2,4) unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
  have part_post: "eq_subsumed (σ state) (insert x (stabl state) - (called state))"
    using Iterate.prems(3,4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
  have nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)
      (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈)"
    using Iterate.prems(3-5) narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post by force
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis
      using Iterate.prems(3) unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def
      apply (intro exI[of _ "post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈"])
      by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    obtain post_state' where
      IH: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state' ∧
           update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
            (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state'"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1) refl Fixpoint(4) pinv nar_inv, of "[]"] Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto

    note c_same = c_same(3)[OF Fixpoint(3,4)]
    have "insert x (post post_state) - ({x} - c⇩n post_state) = post post_state"
      using Iterate.prems(5) Fixpoint(1) by blast

    have parCorr: "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        "(∀y∈dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y)"
      using well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Fixpoint(3,4) pinv]
        eq_subsumed_ind(3)[OF Fixpoint(3,4) _ pinv] part_post Fixpoint(5,6)
      unfolding dep_def
      by simp+

    then show ?thesis
      apply (intro exI[of _ "post_state'⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state' - {x}⦈"])
      using IH
      unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def
      apply (simp add: c_same Fixpoint(5,6)
          ‹insert x (post post_state) - ({x} - c⇩n post_state) = post post_state›)
      by blast
  next
    case (WN_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    obtain post_state' where
      IH: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state'"
          "update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
            (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state'"
      using Iterate(2)[OF WN_Fixpoint(1) refl WN_Fixpoint(4) pinv nar_inv, of "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto

    note c_same = c_same(3)[OF WN_Fixpoint(3,4)]
    have insert_post_simp: "insert x (post post_state) - ({x} - c⇩n post_state) = post post_state"
      using Iterate.prems(5) WN_Fixpoint(1) by blast


    note well_inv1 = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF WN_Fixpoint(3,4) pinv]
    have parCorr: "traverse_rhs (T x) (σ state1) = xd1"
      using well_inv1 eq_subsumed_ind(3)[OF WN_Fixpoint(3,4) _ pinv] part_post
      by simp+
    then have "traverse_rhs (T x) (σ state1) ≤ mlup (σ state') x"
      using WN_Fixpoint(5,6) warrowing_properties(1) by metis
    moreover have "∀y∈dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state') y"
      using well_inv1 IH unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def dep_def by force

    ultimately show ?thesis
      apply (intro exI[of _ "post_state'⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state' - {x}⦈"])
      using IH
      unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def
      by (auto simp add: WN_Fixpoint(7) c_same insert_post_simp)
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    obtain post_state1 where
      IH1: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
        "update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
          (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
      using Iterate(2)[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3) pinv nar_inv, of "[]"] Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto

    have "eq_subsumed (σ state) (insert x (stabl state) - (called state))"
      using Iterate.prems(3,4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    then have parCorr: "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
          "update_rel x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1"
          "eq T x (σ state1) = xd1"
          "(∀y∈dep_aux (σ state1) (T x). x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y)"
          "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(2,3) pinv]
        eq_subsumed_ind(3)[OF Continue(2,3) _ pinv] by force+

    have xcalled1: "x ∈ called state1" and c_same: "called state1 = called state"
      using Iterate.prems(4) c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)] by simp+

    have stabl_incr: "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
    proof -
      have "(slookup (infl state1) ξ - slookup (infl state) ξ) ∩ (stabl state) = {}" for ξ
        using Iterate.prems(3) Continue(1) parCorr by auto
      then show ?thesis
        using Iterate.prems(2) Continue(1) destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)]
          TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1 state x] parCorr
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
    qed

    have pinv2: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
      σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
    proof -
      have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new" using Continue(4) parCorr warrowing_properties(1) by auto
      then show ?thesis
        using parCorr Iterate.prems(2,5) stabl_incr c_same
        apply (intro destab_upd_preserves_well_formed_infl_stabl[OF _ Continue(6), of state])
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def eq_def dep_def
        apply simp_all
        by fastforce
    qed

    have x_in_cn_iff_in_post: "(x ∈ c⇩n post_state) = (x ∈ post post_state)"
      using Iterate.prems(5) Continue(1) by blast

    define x_truly_post where "x_truly_post ≡ x ∈ c⇩n post_state ∨
                                              x ∈ point state ∧ xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
    define c⇩nx where "c⇩nx ≡ (if x_truly_post then insert x (c⇩n post_state1) else c⇩n post_state1)"

    obtain post_state2 where destab_post: "post_state2 =
        destab_post x x_truly_post (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nx⦈) stabl2"
      by (auto split: prod.split)

    have post_incr: "post post_state ⊆ post post_state2"
      apply (intro post_dom_incr[OF Iterate.prems(2) parCorr(1) Iterate.prems(3) IH1(1,2)
             destab_post])
      using x_truly_post_def x_in_cn_iff_in_post by auto

    have c⇩n_post: "(x ∉ c⇩n post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ post post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ stabl2)
          ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ post post_state2)"
      apply (intro c_post_after_destab[OF Continue(6) destab_post post_incr Iterate.prems(3)
            parCorr(1) IH1(1) parCorr(5)])
      subgoal
        using x_in_cn_iff_in_post IH1(2) unfolding c⇩nx_def x_truly_post_def update_rel_nar_def
        by simp
      subgoal unfolding c⇩nx_def by simp
      done

    have nar_inv2: "narrowing_inv (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
        σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new), called := called state1 - {x}⦈)
      (post_state2⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state2 - {x}⦈)"
    proof (cases x_truly_post)
      case True
      have "x ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - c⇩n post_state1)"
        if "x ∈ c⇩n post_state"
        using IH1(2) that c_same unfolding update_rel_nar_def by simp
      then have "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using IH1(1) True parCorr(3) unfolding narrowing_inv_def x_truly_post_def by auto
      have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
        using Continue(4) True parCorr warrowing_properties(1) by auto
      moreover have "d_new ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using Continue(4) ‹xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x› narrowing_le unfolding warrowing_def by auto
      moreover have "post_state2 = post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nx⦈"
        using destab_post True unfolding destab_post_def by simp
      ultimately show ?thesis
        by (auto intro: nar_inv_after_update_if_post[OF assms(1,2) IH1(1)
              parCorr(1,4)[folded dep_def] _ _ Continue(6)] simp add: c⇩nx_def True)
    next
      case False
      then have "c⇩nx = c⇩n post_state1" using c⇩nx_def by auto
      have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
        using Continue(4) False parCorr warrowing_properties(1) by auto
      moreover have "x ∉ c⇩n post_state" "x ∉ post post_state"
        using False x_in_cn_iff_in_post unfolding x_truly_post_def by auto
      ultimately show ?thesis
        using nar_inv_after_destab_update_if_not_post[OF _ _ Iterate.prems(2,3) parCorr(1)
            IH1(1) parCorr(2) IH1(2) destab_post[simplified ‹c⇩nx = c⇩n post_state1›] Continue(6) _
            parCorr(4)[folded dep_def] pinv2 c_same _ False] IH1(2)
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def
        by auto
    qed

    obtain post_state' where IH2:
        "narrowing_inv (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈) post_state'"
        "update_rel_nar x (state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new),
          called := called state1 - {x}⦈) (state'⦇called := called state' - {x}⦈)
          (post_state2⦇c⇩n := insert x (c⇩n post_state2)⦈)
          (post_state'⦇c⇩n := insert x (c⇩n post_state')⦈)"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3) _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(8),
          simplified, OF pinv2 nar_inv2 xcalled1 c⇩n_post]
      by blast

    then show ?thesis
    proof (intro exI[of _ post_state'] conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case by simp
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
        case 1
        then show ?case using post_incr by (auto split: if_splits)
      next
        case 2
        then have "∀u∈post post_state. mlup (σ state') u ≤ mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)) u"
          using post_incr by (auto split: if_splits)
        moreover have "∀u∈post post_state. mlup (σ state1) u ≤ mlup (σ state) u"
          using IH1 unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
        moreover have "mlup ((σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)) u ≤ mlup (σ state1) u"
          if "u ∈ post post_state" for u
        proof (cases "u = x")
          case True
          then have "x ∉ called state1 - c⇩n post_state1"
            using Continue(1) Iterate.prems(5) that c_same IH1(2)
            unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
          then have "x ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - c⇩n post_state1)"
            using that IH1 unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
          then have "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x" using IH1 parCorr unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
          then have "d_new ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
            using Continue(4) narrowing_le unfolding warrowing_def by auto
          then show ?thesis using True by (auto simp add: fun_upd_same mlup_def)
        next
          case False
          then show ?thesis by (auto simp add: fun_upd_other mlup_def)
        qed
        ultimately show ?case by fastforce
      next
        case 3
        show ?case
        proof(intro allI subsetI, goal_cases)
          case (1 ξ u)
          then have "ξ ∈ post post_state"
            using TD.stabl_infl_empty[of _ _ "pinfl post_state"] Iterate.prems(3)
            unfolding narrowing_inv_def
            by auto
          then show ?case
          proof (cases x_truly_post)
            case True
            then have "post_state2 = post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nx⦈"
              using destab_post unfolding destab_post_def by auto
            moreover have "slookup (pinfl post_state) ξ ⊆ slookup (pinfl post_state1) ξ"
              "ξ ∈ post post_state1"
              using ‹ξ ∈ post post_state› IH1 unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
            moreover have "slookup (pinfl post_state2) ξ ⊆ slookup (pinfl post_state') ξ"
              using ‹ξ ∈ post post_state1› ‹post_state2 = post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nx⦈› 3
              unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
            ultimately show ?thesis using 1(1) by auto
          next
            case False
            then have "x ∉ c⇩n post_state" unfolding x_truly_post_def by simp
            then have "x ∉ post post_state" using x_in_cn_iff_in_post by simp
            have "u ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) ξ"
              using IH1 1 unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
            have destab_post: "post_state2 = destab_barrier x (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nx⦈) stabl2"
              using destab_post False unfolding destab_post_def by auto
            have "ξ ≠ x" using ‹ξ ∈ post post_state› ‹x ∉ post post_state› by blast
            have "ξ ∈ post post_state2" using ‹ξ ∈ post post_state› post_incr by blast
            then have "ξ ∉ insert x (influenced_by_excl_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x stabl2)"
              using destab_post ‹ξ ∈ post post_state› ‹ξ ≠ x›
              unfolding destab_barrier_def by auto
            then have "slookup (pinfl post_state1) ξ = slookup (pinfl post_state2) ξ"
              using destab_post unfolding destab_barrier_def
              by (auto simp add: fmlookup_default_drop_set simp del: fmdrop_set_insert)
            then have "u ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state2) ξ"
              using ‹u ∈ slookup (pinfl post_state1) ξ› by auto
            then show ?thesis using 1(1) 3 by auto
          qed
        qed
      next
        case 4
        have "∀u. slookup (pinfl post_state2) u ⊆ slookup (pinfl post_state1) u"
        proof (cases x_truly_post)
          case True
          then show ?thesis using destab_post unfolding destab_post_def by auto
        next
          case False
          have "pinfl post_state2 = fmdrop_set (insert x
              (influenced_by_excl_cutoff (pinfl post_state1) x stabl2)) (pinfl post_state1)"
            using destab_post False unfolding destab_post_def destab_barrier_def by auto
          then show ?thesis
            by (metis Orderings.order_eq_iff empty_set empty_subsetI fmlookup_default_drop_set)
        qed
        moreover have "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state1) u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
          ∩ (post post_state) = {}"
        proof -
          have "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state1) u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
              ∩ (insert x (post post_state) - ({x} - (c⇩n post_state))) = {}"
            using IH1 Continue(1) unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
          then show ?thesis using Iterate.prems(5) Continue(1) by blast
        qed
        moreover have "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state') u - slookup (pinfl post_state2) u)
            ∩ (post post_state2) = {}"
          using 4 c⇩nx_def unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
        moreover have "post post_state ⊆ post post_state2" using post_incr by auto
        ultimately show ?case by fastforce
      next
        case 5
        then show ?case
          using destab_post_c_unchanged[OF destab_post] c⇩nx_def IH1(2)
          unfolding update_rel_nar_def by simp
      qed
    qed
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1)Eval.prems(1)
  proof (cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    have y_dep: "y ∈ dep T (σ state) x"
      using Eval.prems(5) Query(1) subt_for_prefix_implies_subt subt_implies_dep
      unfolding dep_def by fast
    then obtain post_state1 where IH1: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
        "update_rel_nar x state state1 post_state post_state1"
      using Eval(2)[OF Query(1,3) Eval.prems(2-3)] by blast
    have parCorr: "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
        "∀ξ∈stabl state. mlup (σ state) ξ = mlup (σ state1) ξ"
        "x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y"
        "stabl state ⊆ stabl state1"
        "∀u∈stabl state. slookup (infl state) u ⊆ slookup (infl state1) u"
        "∀u. (slookup (infl state1) u - slookup (infl state) u) ∩ (stabl state - {x}) = {}"
      using well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF Query(2,3)] Eval.prems(2,6) by auto

    have "subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [y]) (σ state1) = Some (g yd)"
    proof -
      have "∀u∈set pre. mlup (σ state) u = mlup (σ state1) u" using parCorr Eval.prems(6) by auto
      then have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state1) = Some t"
        using Eval.prems(5) subt_for_prefix_same by metis
      moreover have "subt_for_prefix t [y] (σ state1) = Some (g yd)"
        using Query(1) query_fmlookup[OF Query(2,3)] by auto
      ultimately show ?thesis using subt_for_prefix_transitive by blast
    qed
    moreover have "set (pre @ [y]) ⊆ stabl state1"
    proof -
      have "y ∈ stabl state1"
        using parCorr TD.stabl_infl_empty[of y "stabl state1" "infl state1"]
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
        by fastforce
      then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(6) parCorr by auto
    qed
    ultimately obtain post_state' where
       IH2: "narrowing_inv state' post_state'"
            "update_rel_nar x state1 state' post_state1 post_state'"
      using Eval(3)[OF Query(1,3) refl Query(5) parCorr(1) IH1(1)] Eval.prems(4)
        c_same(1)[OF Query(2,3)]
      by blast
    then have "update_rel_nar x state state' post_state post_state'"
      using IH1 unfolding update_rel_nar_def
    proof (intro conjI, goal_cases)
      case 1
      then show ?case by (simp add: subset_iff)
    next
      case 2
      then show ?case by (meson order_trans subsetD)
    next
      case 3
      then show ?case by (meson dual_order.trans subsetD)
    next
      case 4
      then show ?case
      proof (cases "x ∉ c⇩n post_state")
        case True
        then have A: "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state1) u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
            ∩ (post post_state - {x}) = {}" and
          B: "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state') u - slookup (pinfl post_state1) u)
            ∩ (post post_state1 - {x}) = {}" using 4(2,4) by blast+
        show ?thesis using TD.infl_diff_eval_step[OF _ B A] 4(4) True by auto
      next
        case False
        then have A: "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state1) u - slookup (pinfl post_state) u)
              ∩ (post post_state) = {}" and
          B: "∀u. (slookup (pinfl post_state') u - slookup (pinfl post_state1) u)
              ∩ (post post_state1) = {}"
          using 4(2,4) by auto
        then show ?thesis
        proof(intro allI, goal_cases)
          case (1 ξ)
          then have "((slookup (pinfl post_state') ξ - slookup (pinfl post_state1) ξ)
              ∪ (slookup (pinfl post_state1) ξ - slookup (pinfl post_state) ξ))
              ∩ (post post_state) = {}"
            using 4(4) False by blast
          then show ?case by blast
        qed
      qed
    next
      case 5
      then show ?case by simp
    qed
    then show ?thesis using IH2(1) by auto
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using Eval.prems(3) unfolding update_rel_nar_def by fastforce
  qed
qed



subsubsection ‹Equivalence with Phase Solver for Monotonicity›

text‹For equation systems with monotonic right-hand sides and monotonic dependencies, the warrowing
  solver is equivalent to the TD with widening and narrowing phases when used with a precise
  widening operator. We prove this by relying heavily on the invariants that have been shown to
  hold for the ghost variables @{term c⇩n}, @{term post} and @{term pinfl} in the previous
  subsection. Termination of TD\_warrow and the partial correctness of TD\_wn\_phases then follow
  immediately.›

interpretation TD_wn_phases: TD_wn_phases.TD_wn_phases T "(∇)" "(Δ)"
  done

lemma phase_widen_narrow_incr:
  assumes "d_new = (if x ∉ point state then xd1 else
                    if wn = Widening then mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1 else mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)"
      and "wn = Narrowing ⟶ x ∈ c⇩n post_state1"
      and "well_formed_infl_stabl state1"
      and "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
      and "x ∈ post post_state1"
      and "eq T x (σ state1) = xd1"
    shows "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
proof (cases "x ∈ point state")
  case True
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases wn)
    case Widening
    have "d_new = mlup (σ state1) x ∇ xd1" using assms(1) Widening True by simp
    then have "xd1 ≤ d_new" using widening_ge_2 by auto
    then show ?thesis using assms(6) by simp
  next
    case Narrowing
    then have "x ∈ c⇩n post_state1" using assms(2) by fastforce
    then have "x ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - c⇩n post_state1)" using assms(3,5) by auto
    then have "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x" using assms(4,6) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    then show ?thesis using assms(1,6) True Narrowing narrowing_ge[of xd1 "mlup (σ state1) x"] by auto
  qed
next
  case False
  then show ?thesis using assms(1,4,6) unfolding eq_def by auto
qed

lemma equiv_wn_solver_ind_1:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
    and "mono_deps T"
  shows "TD_wn_phases.query_dom y x state
        ⟹ (xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.query y x state
        ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
        ⟹ narrowing_inv state post_state
        ⟹ x ∈ dep T (σ state)y
        ⟹ query_dom y x state
            ∧ (xd, state') = query y x state"
    and "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x wn state
        ⟹ (xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.iterate x wn state
        ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
        ⟹ narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈)
        ⟹ x ∈ called state
        ⟹ (x ∉ c⇩n post_state ⟶ x ∉ post post_state - stabl state)
            ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state ⟶ x ∈ post post_state)
        ⟹ (wn = Narrowing) ⟶ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state)
        ⟹ iterate_dom x state
            ∧ (xd, state') = iterate x state"
    and "TD_wn_phases.eval_dom x t state
        ⟹ (xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.eval x t state
        ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
        ⟹ narrowing_inv state post_state
        ⟹ x ∈ called state
        ⟹ subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t
        ⟹ set pre ⊆ stabl state
        ⟹ eval_dom x t state
            ∧ (xd, state') = eval x t state"
proof(induction y x state and x wn state and x t state
      arbitrary: post_state xd state' and post_state xd state' and post_state xd state' pre
      rule: TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    obtain c1⇩n where
      c1_def: "c1⇩n = (if x ∈ post post_state then insert x (c⇩n post_state) else c⇩n post_state)"
      by fastforce
    have "(x ∉ c1⇩n ⟶ x ∉ post post_state - stabl state)
        ∧ (x ∈ c1⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post post_state)"
      using c1_def Query.prems(3) Iterate(1) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    moreover have "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := insert x (called state) - {x}⦈)"
      using Iterate(1) Query.prems(2) by auto
    moreover have
        "narrowing_inv (state⦇called := insert x (called state) - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c1⇩n - {x}⦈)"
      using Iterate(1) Query.prems(3) c1_def unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    ultimately have IH: "iterate_dom x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
      "(xd, state1) = iterate x (state ⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,3), of "post_state⦇c⇩n := c1⇩n⦈"] by auto
    then have "query_dom y x state"
      using query_iterate_eval.domintros(1)[of x state] Query.prems(4) Iterate(1,4)
      by (auto split: if_splits)
    then show ?thesis
      using query.psimps[folded dom_defs] Iterate(1,4) IH(2) Query.prems(4)
      by (auto split: prod.splits if_splits)
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using query_iterate_eval.domintros(1)[of x state] Query.prems(4) by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x wn state)
  have xcalled: "x ∈ called state" using Iterate.prems(4,5) by auto
  have winv: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Iterate.prems(2,4,5) unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
  have pinv: "eq_subsumed (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))
      (stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) - called (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))"
    using Iterate.prems(3,4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
  have nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)
      (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈)"
    using narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post[OF Iterate.prems(4,5,3)] by auto
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: TD_wn_phases.iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state, folded dom_defs] by auto
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    have IH1: "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      "(xd, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1) refl Fixpoint(4) winv nar_inv, where ?pre1 = "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto
    have "iterate_dom x state"
      using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state, folded dom_defs] Fixpoint(2,5,6) IH1
        query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
    then show ?thesis
      using IH1 Fixpoint(1,2,5,6)
      by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") simp
  next
    case (W_Fixpoint xd1 state1 infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF W_Fixpoint(1) refl W_Fixpoint(5) winv nar_inv, where ?pre1 = "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto

    note part_correct = eq_subsumed_ind(3)[OF IH1 _ winv pinv, simplified]
    note wellformed_stabl = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF IH1 winv, simplified]
    note c_same = c_same(3)[OF IH1]
    obtain post_state1 where narInv: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
      "update_rel_nar x (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
        (post_state ⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
      using narrowing_inv_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) IH1 winv nar_inv, of "[]"] Iterate.prems(4-5)
      by auto

    have stabl_incr: "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
    proof -
      have "(slookup (infl state1) ξ - slookup (infl state) ξ) ∩ (stabl state) = {}" for ξ
        using Iterate.prems(3) W_Fixpoint(1) wellformed_stabl
        by auto
      then show ?thesis
        using Iterate.prems(2) W_Fixpoint(1) TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1 state x]
          destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF W_Fixpoint(8)] wellformed_stabl
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
    qed

    let ?state2 = "state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
       σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1)⦈"
    let ?post_state2 = "post_state1⦇c⇩n := insert x (c⇩n post_state1)⦈"

    have xd1_smaller: "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
      using wellformed_stabl W_Fixpoint(6) widening_ge_2 by metis
    have sigma_narrow_smaller: "(σ state1)(x ↦ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1) ⊑⇩m σ state1"
    proof -
      have "mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x" using narrowing_le xd1_smaller by simp
      then show ?thesis unfolding mlup_def by (simp add: fun_upd_apply)
    qed
    have "x ∈ post post_state1" using narInv unfolding update_rel_nar_def by simp
    have A: "(x ∉ insert x (c⇩n post_state1) ⟶ x ∈ post post_state1 ⟶ x ∈ stabl2)
        ∧ (x ∈ insert x (c⇩n post_state1) ⟶ x ∈ post post_state1)"
      using ‹x ∈ post post_state1› by simp
    have w_inv2: "well_formed_infl_stabl (?state2⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
    proof -
      have "∀x∈stabl state1 - (called state1 - {x}). ∀y∈dep T (σ state1) x. x ∈ slookup (infl state1) y"
        using wellformed_stabl unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def dep_def by auto
      moreover have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1"
        by (metis eq_def narrowing_ge xd1_smaller part_correct)
      ultimately show ?thesis
        apply (intro destab_upd_preserves_well_formed_infl_stabl[OF _ W_Fixpoint(8) _ _ stabl_incr])
        using wellformed_stabl Iterate.prems(2) c_same
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def eq_def by auto
    qed
    have nar_inv2:
      "narrowing_inv (?state2⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈) (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state1 - {x}⦈)"
    proof -
      have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1"
        by (metis eq_def narrowing_ge part_correct xd1_smaller)
      moreover have "mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using xd1_smaller by (simp add: narrowing_le)
      moreover have "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
        using narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post ‹x ∈ post post_state1› narInv(1)
        unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
      ultimately show ?thesis
        apply (intro nar_inv_after_update_if_post[OF assms(1,2)])
        using W_Fixpoint(8) wellformed_stabl Iterate.prems(5) unfolding destab_post_def dep_def
        by simp_all
    qed

    have IH2: "iterate_dom x ?state2" "(xd, state') = iterate x ?state2"
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF W_Fixpoint(1) refl W_Fixpoint(5) _ _ W_Fixpoint(6) _ refl
          W_Fixpoint(7,8) _ W_Fixpoint(10), of "post_state1⦇c⇩n := insert x (c⇩n post_state1)⦈",
          simplified, OF _ w_inv2 nar_inv2] W_Fixpoint(2-3)
          ‹x ∈ post post_state1› Iterate.prems(4) c_same
      unfolding iterate_dom_def by auto

    have war_is_nar: "mlup (σ state1) x ∇Δ xd1 = mlup (σ state1) x Δ xd1"
      using xd1_smaller unfolding warrowing_def by auto
    then have "iterate_dom x state"
      using W_Fixpoint(1-3,7,8) IH1 IH2(1) query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
      by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
          cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)", cases wn) auto
    then show ?thesis using iterate.psimps W_Fixpoint(1,2,3,7,8) IH1(2) IH2(2) war_is_nar
      by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
          cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") simp
  next
    case (N_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    have IH1: "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF N_Fixpoint(1) refl N_Fixpoint(5) winv nar_inv, where ?pre1 = "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto

    note part_correct = eq_subsumed_ind(3)[OF IH1 _ winv pinv, simplified]
    note wellformed_stabl = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF IH1 winv, simplified]
    obtain post_state1 where narInv: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
      "update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
        (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
      using narrowing_inv_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) IH1 winv nar_inv, of "[]"] Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto
    note c_same = c_same(3)[OF IH1]

    have "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state') x"
    proof (cases wn)
      case Widening
      then show ?thesis using N_Fixpoint(3) widening_ge_2[of xd1 "mlup (σ state') x"] by auto
    next
      case Narrowing
      then have "x ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - c⇩n post_state1)"
        using Iterate.prems(5,6) narInv(2) c_same unfolding update_rel_nar_def by auto
      then have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using narInv(1)  unfolding narrowing_inv_def by simp
      then show ?thesis
        using conjunct2[OF part_correct, symmetric] N_Fixpoint(8) by simp
    qed
    then have war_fix: "mlup (σ state') x = mlup (σ state') x ∇Δ xd1"
      using N_Fixpoint(6,7) unfolding warrowing_def by metis
    have "iterate_dom x state"
      using query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state] IH1 N_Fixpoint(2,8) war_fix
      by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") simp
    then show ?thesis
      using iterate.psimps[of x state] IH1 N_Fixpoint(1-3,6-8) war_fix
      by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") simp
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "eval_dom x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      "(xd1, state1) = eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3) winv nar_inv, where ?pre1 = "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4-6)
      by auto

    note c_same = c_same(3)[OF IH1]
    note part_correct = eq_subsumed_ind(3)[OF IH1 _ winv pinv, simplified]
    note wellformed_stabl = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF IH1 winv, simplified]
    obtain post_state1 where narInv: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
      "update_rel_nar x (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
        (post_state ⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
      using narrowing_inv_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) IH1 winv nar_inv, of "[]"] Iterate.prems(4-6)
      by auto

    have stabl_incr: "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
    proof -
      have "(slookup (infl state1) ξ - slookup (infl state) ξ) ∩ (stabl state) = {}" for ξ
        using Iterate.prems(3) Continue(1) wellformed_stabl
        by auto
      then show ?thesis
        using Iterate.prems(2) Continue(1) TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1 _ x]
          destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)] wellformed_stabl
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
    qed

    let ?state2 = "state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈"

    let ?x_truly_post = "x ∈ c⇩n post_state"
    have x_cn_iff_post: "(x ∈ c⇩n post_state) = (x ∈ post post_state)"
      using Iterate.prems(5) Continue(1) by auto
    obtain post_state2 where destab_post:
        "post_state2 = destab_post x ?x_truly_post post_state1 stabl2"
      by (cases "destab_post x ?x_truly_post post_state1 stabl2") fastforce

    have post_incr: "post post_state ⊆ post post_state2"
      apply (intro post_dom_incr[OF Iterate.prems(2) conjunct1[OF wellformed_stabl]
            Iterate.prems(3) narInv(1,2), of _ ?x_truly_post "c⇩n post_state1"])
      using destab_post x_cn_iff_post
      by simp+

    have winv2: "well_formed_infl_stabl (?state2⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
    proof -
      have "x ∈ post post_state1"
        using wellformed_stabl narInv(1) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
      then have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
        apply (intro phase_widen_narrow_incr[OF Continue(4) _ conjunct1[OF wellformed_stabl]
              narInv(1)])
        using Iterate.prems(6) narInv(2) conjunct2[OF part_correct, folded eq_def]
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def
        by simp_all
      then show ?thesis
        apply (intro destab_upd_preserves_well_formed_infl_stabl[OF _ Continue(6) _ _ stabl_incr])
        using Iterate.prems(2) wellformed_stabl c_same
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def dep_def
        by auto
    qed
    have nar_inv2:
      "narrowing_inv (?state2⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈) (post_state2⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state2 - {x}⦈)"
    proof (cases ?x_truly_post)
      case True
      then have "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using IH1 part_correct narInv unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def by auto
      then have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
        using Continue(4) True widening_precise narrowing_ge part_correct
        unfolding eq_def by (cases wn) auto
      moreover have "d_new ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using ‹xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x› Continue(4) widening_precise narrowing_le by auto
      ultimately show ?thesis
        using nar_inv_after_update_if_post[OF assms(1,2)] Continue(6) wellformed_stabl True
          destab_post narInv(1)
        unfolding dep_def destab_post_def by auto
    next
      case False
      then have "x ∉ post post_state" using x_cn_iff_post by simp
      have "x ∈ post post_state1"
        using wellformed_stabl narInv(1) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by blast
      then have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
        apply (intro phase_widen_narrow_incr[OF Continue(4) _ conjunct1[OF wellformed_stabl]
              narInv(1)])
        using narInv(2) Iterate.prems(6) part_correct
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def eq_def by auto
      moreover have "x ∉ post post_state" using False x_cn_iff_post by fastforce
      ultimately show ?thesis
        apply (intro nar_inv_after_destab_update_if_not_post[OF _ False Iterate.prems(2,3)
              conjunct1[OF wellformed_stabl] narInv(1) _ narInv(2) _ Continue(6) _ _ winv2 _ _
              False])
        using destab_post wellformed_stabl Continue(6)
        unfolding dep_def
        apply simp_all
        using c_same narInv(2)
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def
        by simp_all
    qed

    have "(x ∉ c⇩n post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ post post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ stabl2)
      ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ post post_state2)"
    proof -
      have "x ∈ stabl state1" "x ∈ post post_state1" "c⇩n post_state1 = c⇩n post_state"
        using wellformed_stabl narInv IH1 xcalled
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def update_rel_nar_def by auto
      then show ?thesis
        apply (intro c_post_after_destab[OF Continue(6) _ post_incr Iterate.prems(3)
            conjunct1[OF wellformed_stabl] narInv(1), of "x ∈ c⇩n post_state" "c⇩n post_state1"])
        using destab_post x_cn_iff_post by fastforce+
    qed
    then have IH2: "iterate_dom x ?state2" "(xd, state') = iterate x ?state2"
      using Iterate.IH(4)[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3) refl Continue(4,5,6) refl Continue(8),
          where ?post_state1=post_state2]
        winv2 nar_inv2 destab_post_c_unchanged[OF destab_post] narInv(2) c_same Iterate.prems(4,6)
      unfolding update_rel_nar_def
      by simp_all

    have d_new_war: "d_new = (if x ∉ (point state) then xd1 else mlup (σ state1) x ∇Δ xd1)"
      using Continue(4)
    proof (cases wn)
      case Widening
      then show ?thesis using Continue(4,5) warrowing_def widening_precise by force
    next
      case Narrowing
      then have "x ∈ c⇩n post_state - (called state - c⇩n post_state)" using Iterate.prems(4-6) by auto
      then have "x ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - c⇩n post_state1)"
        using wellformed_stabl narInv(1,2) c_same
        unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def by auto
      then have "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using part_correct narInv unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
      then show ?thesis using Continue(4) Narrowing unfolding warrowing_def by auto
    qed
    have "iterate_dom x state"
    proof (cases "x ∈ point state")
      case True
      show ?thesis
        using True Continue(1,5,6) IH1 IH2(1) query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
          d_new_war
        by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)", cases
          "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") (auto split: if_splits simp del: eval.psimps)
    next
      case False
      then show ?thesis
        using Continue(1,4,5,6) IH1 IH2(1) query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
        by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)", cases
          "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") (auto split: if_splits)
    qed
    then show ?thesis
      using iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs] Continue(1,5-6) IH1(2) IH2(2) d_new_war
      by (cases "eval x (T x) (state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)", cases
          "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") auto
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: TD_wn_phases.eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    have y_dep: "y ∈ dep T (σ state)x"
      using Eval.prems(5) Query(1) subt_for_prefix_implies_subt subt_implies_dep
      unfolding dep_def by fast
    then have IH1: "query_dom x y state"
      "(yd, state1) = query x y state"
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2-6) by auto

    note c_same = c_same(1)[OF IH1]
    note wellformed_stabl = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF IH1 Eval.prems(2)]
    obtain post_state1 where narInv: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1
      ∧ update_rel_nar x state state1 post_state post_state1"
      using narrowing_inv_ind(1)[OF assms(1,2) IH1 Eval.prems(2,3) y_dep] by auto

    have "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using Eval.prems(4) wellformed_stabl c_same unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
    have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state1) = Some t"
      apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same)
      using Eval.prems(5,6) wellformed_stabl
      by auto
    moreover have "subt_for_prefix t [y] (σ state1) = Some (g yd)"
      using wellformed_stabl query_fmlookup[OF IH1] Query(1) by simp
    ultimately have F1: "subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [y]) (σ state1) = Some (g yd)"
      using subt_for_prefix_transitive by blast
    have "y ∈ stabl state1"
      using wellformed_stabl TD.stabl_infl_empty unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
      by (metis empty_iff)
    then have F2: "set (pre @ [y]) ⊆ stabl state1"
      using ‹set pre ⊆ stabl state› wellformed_stabl by auto

    have IH2: "eval_dom x (g yd) state1"
      "(xd, state') = eval x (g yd) state1"
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ Query(5)] Eval.prems(4) c_same wellformed_stabl narInv
        ‹x ∈ stabl state1› F1 F2
      by auto
    have "eval_dom x t state"
      apply (rule query_iterate_eval.domintros(3)[folded dom_defs])
      using Query(1) IH1 IH2(1)
      by (auto split: prod.splits)
    then show ?thesis
      using eval.psimps[folded dom_defs] Query(1) IH1(2) IH2(2) by (auto split: prod.splits)
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis using query_iterate_eval.domintros(3)[of t] by simp
  qed
qed

lemma equiv_wn_solver_ind_2:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
    and "mono_deps T"
  shows "query_dom y x state
        ⟹ (xd, state') = query y x state
        ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
        ⟹ narrowing_inv state post_state
        ⟹ x ∈ dep T (σ state)y
        ⟹ TD_wn_phases.query_dom y x state
            ∧ (xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.query y x state"
    and "iterate_dom x state
        ⟹ (xd, state') = iterate x state
        ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)
        ⟹ narrowing_inv (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈) (post_state⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state - {x}⦈)
        ⟹ x ∈ called state
        ⟹ (x ∉ c⇩n post_state ⟶ x ∉ post post_state - stabl state)
            ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state ⟶ x ∈ post post_state)
        ⟹ wn = Narrowing ⟶ x ∈ c⇩n post_state
        ⟹ TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x wn state
            ∧ (xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.iterate x wn state"
    and "eval_dom x t state
        ⟹ (xd, state') = eval x t state
        ⟹ well_formed_infl_stabl state
        ⟹ narrowing_inv state post_state
        ⟹ x ∈ called state
        ⟹ subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state) = Some t
        ⟹ set pre ⊆ stabl state
        ⟹ TD_wn_phases.eval_dom x t state
            ∧ (xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.eval x t state"
proof(induction y x state and x state and y t state
      arbitrary: post_state xd state' and wn post_state xd state' and post_state xd state' pre
      rule: query_iterate_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query y x state)
  show ?case using Query.IH(1) Query.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: query_iterate_lookup_cases)
    case (Iterate state1)
    obtain c1⇩n where c1_def:
      "c1⇩n = (if x ∈ post post_state then insert x (c⇩n post_state) else c⇩n post_state)"
      by fastforce
    have "c1⇩n ⊆ insert x (called state)" using c1_def Query.prems(3) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    have "(x ∉ c1⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post post_state ⟶ x ∈ stabl state) ∧
        (x ∈ c1⇩n ⟶ x ∈ post post_state)"
      using c1_def Query.prems(3) Iterate(1) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    moreover have "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇called := insert x (called state) - {x}⦈)"
      using Iterate(1) Query.prems(2) by auto
    moreover have "narrowing_inv (state⦇called := insert x (called state) - {x}⦈)
        (post_state⦇c⇩n := c1⇩n - {x}⦈)"
      using Iterate(1) Query.prems(3) c1_def unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
    ultimately have IH: "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
      "(xd, state1) = TD_wn_phases.iterate x Widening (state⦇called := insert x (called state)⦈)"
      using Query.IH(2)[OF Iterate(1,3), of "post_state⦇c⇩n := c1⇩n⦈" Widening] by simp+
    then show ?thesis
      using TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(1)[of x state] Iterate(1,4)
      by (auto split: prod.splits)
  next
    case Lookup
    then show ?thesis using TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(1)[of x state] by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state)
  have winv: "well_formed_infl_stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
    using Iterate.prems(2,4,5) unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
  have pinv: "eq_subsumed (σ (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))
     (stabl (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) - called (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈))"
    using Iterate.prems(3,4) unfolding narrowing_inv_def by auto
  have nar_inv: "narrowing_inv (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)
      (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈)"
    using narrow_inv_add_x_stabl_and_post[OF Iterate.prems(4,5,3)] by auto
  show ?case using Iterate.IH(1) Iterate.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: iterate_continue_fixpoint_cases)
    case Stable
    then show ?thesis
      using TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state] by fastforce
  next
    case (Fixpoint state1)
    have IH1: "TD_wn_phases.eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      "(xd, state1) = TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Fixpoint(1) refl Fixpoint(4) winv nar_inv, where ?pre1 = "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto
    have "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x wn state"
      using Fixpoint(1,2,5,6) IH1 TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state wn]
      by (cases "TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
    then show ?thesis
      using IH1 Fixpoint(1,2,5,6)
      by (cases "TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") auto
  next
    case (WN_Fixpoint xd1 state1)
    have IH1: "TD_wn_phases.eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      "(xd1, state1) = TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF WN_Fixpoint(1) refl WN_Fixpoint(4) winv nar_inv, where ?pre1 = "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto

    note part_correct = eq_subsumed_ind(3)[OF WN_Fixpoint(3,4) _ winv pinv, simplified]
    note wellformed_stabl = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF WN_Fixpoint(3,4) winv, simplified]
    obtain post_state1 where narInv: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
      "update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
        (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
      using narrowing_inv_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) WN_Fixpoint(3,4) winv nar_inv, of "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4-5) by auto

    have "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state') x" using WN_Fixpoint(5,6) warrowing_properties(2) by blast
    then have w_fix: "mlup (σ state') x ∇ xd1 = mlup (σ state') x"
      using widening_precise by simp
    have n_fix: "mlup (σ state') x Δ xd1 = mlup (σ state') x"
      using WN_Fixpoint(5,6) ‹xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state') x› unfolding warrowing_def by simp
    have "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x wn state"
      using WN_Fixpoint(1-3,6,7) IH1 w_fix n_fix
        TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state]
      by (cases "TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") simp
    then show ?thesis
      using TD_wn_phases.iterate.psimps[of x Widening state]
        IH1(2) WN_Fixpoint(1-2,6-7) w_fix n_fix
      by (cases "TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)") simp
  next
    case (Continue xd1 state1 d_new infl2 stabl2)
    have IH1: "TD_wn_phases.eval_dom x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      "(xd1, state1) = TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)"
      using Iterate.IH(2)[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3) winv nar_inv, where ?pre1 = "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto

    note wellformed_stabl = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(3)[OF Continue(2,3) winv, simplified]
    note part_correct = eq_subsumed_ind(3)[OF Continue(2,3) _ winv pinv, simplified]
    obtain post_state1 where narInv: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1"
      "update_rel_nar x (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) state1
        (post_state⦇post := insert x (post post_state)⦈) post_state1"
      using narrowing_inv_ind(3)[OF assms(1,2) Continue(2,3) winv nar_inv, of "[]"]
        Iterate.prems(4)
      by auto

    have xcalled1: "x ∈ called state1" and c_same: "called state1 = called state"
      using Iterate.prems(4) c_same(3)[OF Continue(2,3)] by simp+

    have stabl_incr: "stabl state ⊆ stabl2"
    proof -
      have "(slookup (infl state1) ξ - slookup (infl state) ξ) ∩ (stabl state) = {}" for ξ
        using Iterate.prems(3) Continue(1) wellformed_stabl by auto
      then show ?thesis
        using Iterate.prems(2) Continue(1) destab_infl_stabl_relation[OF Continue(6)]
          TD.new_lookup_to_infl_not_stabl[of state1 state x]
          wellformed_stabl
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by auto
    qed

    let ?state2 = "state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(x ↦ d_new)⦈"

    have pinv2: "well_formed_infl_stabl (?state2⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)"
    proof -
      have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
        using Continue(4) part_correct warrowing_properties(1) by auto
      then show ?thesis
        using wellformed_stabl Iterate.prems(2,5) stabl_incr c_same
        apply (intro destab_upd_preserves_well_formed_infl_stabl[OF _ Continue(6), of state])
        unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def eq_def dep_def
        apply simp_all
        by fastforce
    qed

    have x_in_cn_iff_in_post: "(x ∈ c⇩n post_state) = (x ∈ post post_state)"
      using Iterate.prems(5) Continue(1) by blast

    define x_truly_post where "x_truly_post ≡ x ∈ c⇩n post_state ∨
                                              x ∈ point state ∧ xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
    define c⇩nx where "c⇩nx ≡ (if x_truly_post then insert x (c⇩n post_state1) else c⇩n post_state1)"

    obtain post_state2 where destab_post: "post_state2 =
        destab_post x x_truly_post (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩nx⦈) stabl2"
      by (auto split: prod.split)

    have post_incr: "post post_state ⊆ post post_state2"
      apply (intro post_dom_incr[OF Iterate.prems(2) conjunct1[OF wellformed_stabl]
             Iterate.prems(3) narInv(1,2) destab_post])
      using x_truly_post_def x_in_cn_iff_in_post by auto

    have c⇩n_post: "(x ∉ c⇩n post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ post post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ stabl2)
          ∧ (x ∈ c⇩n post_state2 ⟶ x ∈ post post_state2)"
      apply (intro c_post_after_destab[OF Continue(6) destab_post post_incr Iterate.prems(3)
            conjunct1[OF wellformed_stabl] narInv(1)])
      using x_in_cn_iff_in_post narInv(2) wellformed_stabl
      unfolding c⇩nx_def x_truly_post_def update_rel_nar_def
      by simp+

    have nar_inv2: "narrowing_inv (?state2⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)
      (post_state2⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state2 - {x}⦈)"
    proof (cases x_truly_post)
      case True
      have "x ∈ post post_state1 - (called state1 - c⇩n post_state1)"
        if "x ∈ c⇩n post_state"
        using narInv(2) that c_same unfolding update_rel_nar_def by simp
      then have "xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using narInv(1) True part_correct unfolding narrowing_inv_def x_truly_post_def by auto
      have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
        using Continue(4) True part_correct warrowing_properties(1) by auto
      moreover have "d_new ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
        using Continue(4) ‹xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x› narrowing_le unfolding warrowing_def by auto
      ultimately have "narrowing_inv (?state2⦇called := called state1 - {x}⦈)
          (post_state1⦇c⇩n := c⇩n post_state1 - {x}⦈)"
        apply (intro nar_inv_after_update_if_post[OF assms(1,2) narInv(1)
              conjunct1[OF wellformed_stabl] _ _ _ Continue(6)])
        using wellformed_stabl destab_post True c⇩nx_def
        unfolding dep_def
        by simp_all
      then show ?thesis using destab_post True c⇩nx_def unfolding destab_post_def by auto
    next
      case False
      then have "c⇩nx = c⇩n post_state1" using c⇩nx_def by auto
      have "eq T x (σ state1) ≤ d_new"
        using Continue(4) False part_correct warrowing_properties(1) by auto
      moreover have "x ∉ c⇩n post_state" "x ∉ post post_state"
        using False x_in_cn_iff_in_post unfolding x_truly_post_def by auto
      ultimately show ?thesis
        using nar_inv_after_destab_update_if_not_post[OF _ _ Iterate.prems(2,3) _
            narInv(1) _ narInv(2) destab_post[simplified ‹c⇩nx = c⇩n post_state1›] Continue(6) _
            _ pinv2 c_same _ False] narInv(2) wellformed_stabl[folded dep_def]
        unfolding update_rel_nar_def
        by auto
    qed

    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "x ∉ point state ∨ ¬ xd1 ≤ mlup (σ state1) x"
           rule: case_split[case_names Not_Post Post])
      case Not_Post

      have "wn = Narrowing ⟶ x ∈ c⇩n post_state2"
        using Iterate.prems(6) destab_post
        unfolding c⇩nx_def destab_post_def x_truly_post_def
        by simp
      then have IH2:
          "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x wn ?state2"
          "(xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.iterate x wn ?state2"
        using Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3) _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(8)]
          pinv2 nar_inv2 xcalled1 c⇩n_post
        by simp+

      have "x ∉ point state ∨ wn = Widening"
        using Not_Post narInv part_correct Iterate.prems(6) x_in_cn_iff_in_post
        unfolding narrowing_inv_def update_rel_nar_def
        by (cases wn) auto

      then have iterate_dom: "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x wn state"
        using Continue(1,4-6) IH1 IH2(1) Not_Post
          TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[of x state wn]
        unfolding warrowing_def
        by (cases "x ∈ point state";
            cases "TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
            cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") (auto split: if_splits)

      then show ?thesis
        using TD_wn_phases.iterate.psimps[folded TD_wn_phases.dom_defs, OF iterate_dom]
          Continue(1,4-6) IH1(2) IH2(2) Not_Post ‹x ∉ point state ∨ wn = Widening›
        unfolding warrowing_def
        by (cases "TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
            cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") (auto split: if_splits)
    next
      case Post
      have "x ∈ post post_state1" using narInv unfolding update_rel_nar_def by simp

      have "x ∈ c⇩n post_state2"
        using destab_post_c_unchanged[OF destab_post] Post
        unfolding c⇩nx_def x_truly_post_def
        by (auto split: if_splits)
      then have IH2:
        "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x phase ?state2"
        "(xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.iterate x phase ?state2" for phase
      using Iterate.IH(3)[OF Continue(1) refl Continue(3) _ Continue(4-6) _ Continue(8)]
        pinv2 nar_inv2 xcalled1 c⇩n_post
      by simp+

      have "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x wn state"
        using TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(2)[folded TD_wn_phases.dom_defs,
              of x state wn] IH1 IH2 Continue(4,6) Post widening_precise
        unfolding warrowing_def
        by (cases "TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
            cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") auto

      then show ?thesis
        using Continue(1,4,5,6) Post IH1(2) widening_precise IH2(2)
        unfolding warrowing_def
        by (cases "TD_wn_phases.eval x (T x) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈)",
            cases "destab x (infl state1) (stabl state1)") auto
    qed
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t state)
  show ?case using Eval.IH(1) Eval.prems(1)
  proof(cases rule: eval_query_answer_cases)
    case (Query y g yd state1)
    have y_dep: "y ∈ dep T (σ state)x"
      using Eval.prems(5) Query(1) subt_for_prefix_implies_subt dep_def subt_implies_dep by fast
    then have IH1: "TD_wn_phases.query_dom x y state"
      "(yd, state1) = TD_wn_phases.query x y state"
      using Eval.IH(2)[OF Query(1,3)] Eval.prems(2-6) by auto

    note c_same = c_same(1)[OF Query(2,3)]
    note wellformed_stabl = well_formed_infl_stabl_ind(1)[OF Query(2,3) Eval.prems(2)]
    obtain post_state1 where narInv: "narrowing_inv state1 post_state1
      ∧ update_rel_nar x state state1 post_state post_state1"
      using narrowing_inv_ind(1)[OF assms(1,2) Query(2,3) Eval.prems(2,3) y_dep] by auto

    have "x ∈ stabl state1"
      using Eval.prems(4) wellformed_stabl c_same unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def by fast
    have "subt_for_prefix (T x) pre (σ state1) = Some t"
      apply (subst subt_for_prefix_same)
      using Eval.prems(5,6) wellformed_stabl
      by auto
    moreover have "subt_for_prefix t [y] (σ state1) = Some (g yd)"
      using wellformed_stabl query_fmlookup[OF Query(2,3)] Query(1) by simp
    ultimately have F1: "subt_for_prefix (T x) (pre @ [y]) (σ state1) = Some (g yd)"
      using subt_for_prefix_transitive by blast
    have "y ∈ stabl state1"
      using wellformed_stabl TD.stabl_infl_empty unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def
      by (metis empty_iff)
    then have F2: "set (pre @ [y]) ⊆ stabl state1"
      using ‹set pre ⊆ stabl state› wellformed_stabl by auto

    have IH2: "TD_wn_phases.eval_dom x (g yd) state1"
      "(xd, state') = TD_wn_phases.eval x (g yd) state1"
      using Eval.IH(3)[OF Query(1,3) _ Query(5)] Eval.prems(4) c_same wellformed_stabl narInv
        ‹x ∈ stabl state1› F1 F2 by auto
    have "TD_wn_phases.eval_dom x t state"
      apply (rule TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(3)[folded TD_wn_phases.dom_defs])
      using Query(1) IH1 IH2 by (auto split: prod.splits)
    then show ?thesis
      using eval.psimps[folded dom_defs] Query(1) IH1(2) IH2(2) by (auto split: prod.splits)
  next
    case Answer
    then show ?thesis
      using TD_wn_phases.query_iterate_eval.domintros(3)[of t] by simp
  qed
qed

corollary TD_wn_phases_TD_warrow_equivalence:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
      and "mono_deps T"
    shows "TD_wn_phases.solve_dom x ∧ TD_wn_phases.solve x = (sigma, vars)
           ⟷ solve_dom x ∧ solve x = (sigma, vars)"
proof
  assume solve: "TD_wn_phases.solve_dom x ∧ TD_wn_phases.solve x = (sigma, vars)"
  obtain xd state where "(xd, state) = TD_wn_phases.iterate x Widening
      ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"
      and vars_sigma: "vars = stabl state" "sigma = σ state"
    using solve unfolding TD_wn_phases.solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
  then have "iterate_dom x ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"
    "(xd, state) = iterate x ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"
    using equiv_wn_solver_ind_1(2)[OF assms(1-2) conjunct1[OF solve,
          unfolded TD_wn_phases.solve_dom_def], of xd state "⦇c⇩n = {}, pinfl = fmempty, post = {}⦈"]
    unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def narrowing_inv_def
    by auto
  then show "solve_dom x ∧ solve x = (sigma, vars)"
    using vars_sigma unfolding solve_dom_def solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
next
  assume solve: "solve_dom x ∧ solve x = (sigma, vars)"
  obtain xd state where "(xd, state) =
      iterate x ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"
    and vars_sigma: "vars = stabl state" "sigma = σ state"
    using solve unfolding solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
  then have "TD_wn_phases.iterate_dom x Widening
      ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"
    "(xd, state) = TD_wn_phases.iterate x Widening
      ⦇called = {x}, σ = Map.empty, infl = fmempty, stabl = {}, point = {}⦈"
    using equiv_wn_solver_ind_2(2)[OF assms(1-2) conjunct1[OF solve, unfolded solve_dom_def],
        of xd state "⦇c⇩n = {}, pinfl = fmempty, post = {}⦈" Widening]
    unfolding well_formed_infl_stabl_def narrowing_inv_def
    by auto
  then show "TD_wn_phases.solve_dom x ∧ TD_wn_phases.solve x = (sigma, vars)"
    using vars_sigma unfolding TD_wn_phases.solve_dom_def TD_wn_phases.solve_def
    by (auto split: prod.splits)
qed

end


subsubsection ‹Termination of Warrowing TD›

locale TD_warrow_mono_term = TD_warrow_mono T widening narrowing
  for T :: "('x, 'd :: order_bot) eqsT"
    and widening :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "∇" 65)
    and narrowing :: "'d ⇒ 'd ⇒ 'd" (infixl "Δ" 70) +

  fixes widening_chains narrowing_chains :: "('d × 'd) set"
  defines widening_chains: "widening_chains ≡ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y ∇ a}"
    and narrowing_chains: "narrowing_chains ≡ {(x,y). ∃a. x ≠ y ∧ x = y Δ a}"
  assumes widening_finite: "wf widening_chains"
    and narrowing_finite: "wf narrowing_chains"

    and finite_vars: "finite (UNIV :: 'x set)"
begin

interpretation TD_wn_phases_term: TD_wn_phases.TD_wn_phases_term "(∇)" "(Δ)"
  using widening_finite narrowing_finite finite_vars
  unfolding TD_wn_phases_term_def widening_chains
    narrowing_chains
  by auto

corollary TD_warrow_terminating:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
      and "mono_deps T"
    shows"solve_dom x"
proof -
  have "TD_wn_phases_term.solve_dom x" by (simp add: TD_wn_phases_term.solve_termination)
  then show ?thesis using TD_wn_phases_TD_warrow_equivalence assms(1,2) by (meson old.prod.exhaust)
qed

subsubsection ‹Correctness of Phase TD›

corollary TD_wn_phases_partial_correctness:
  assumes "is_mono_eq T"
      and "mono_deps T"
      and "TD_wn_phases_term.solve x = (sigma, vars)"
    shows "part_post_solution T x sigma vars"
proof -
  have "solve_dom x" "solve x = (sigma, vars)"
    using TD_wn_phases_TD_warrow_equivalence TD_wn_phases_term.solve_termination assms
    by auto
  then show ?thesis using partial_correctness by auto
qed

end
